|vt	 sa yathāśnaṃś ca pibaṃś ceyād evam evaitad etābhyāṃ yanty ā mahāvratīyād 
ahnaḥ 
|vu	 ta etaṃ svargaṃ lokam āgacchanti 
|vv	 etan mahāvratīyam ahaḥ 
|vw	 eṣa vāva svargo loko yan mahāvratīyam ahaḥ 
|vx	 sa ya etad evaṃ veda trirupetam asya mahāvrataṃ bhavati gacchati svargaṃ lokam 
/8/


JB 2.9
|va	 tad āhus <tam īṃ hinvanty agruva> ity evaitasyāhnaḥ pratipat kāryeti 
|vb	 <tam arkebhis taṃ sāmabhir> iti śīrṣṇas <tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham> ity 
ātmanaḥ 
|vc	 <tat tad> itīva vā etenāhnā caranti 
|vd	 tato ha vai prajāpatiḥ 
|ve	 tato ha vā eṣa sarvāsāṃ devatānām 
|vf	 tat pitaitad ahaḥ prajetarāṇi 
|vg	 sa yathā putraḥ pitaram āgatya tata tateti hvayet tādṛk tat 
|vh	 so vā ubhayarūpā bhavati 
|vi	 <tam> iti vai puṃso rūpam <agruva> iti striyai 
|vj	 ubhayam u ha vā etad bhūtvā prajāpatiḥ prajajñe 
|vk	 tad āhur abhyudite vaiṣā pratipat 
|vl	 yoge tv āgate <pavasva vāco agriya> ity eva pratipat kāryeti 
|vm	 mano vai prajāpatiḥ 
|vn	 mano vai vāco 'gram 
|vo	 tad enaṃ tat svenaiva rūpeṇārabhante 
|vp	 so vai mithunābhavati 
|vq	 <pavasve>ti vai puṃso rūpaṃ <vāca> iti striyai 
|vr	 tad etan mithunaṃ prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vs	 mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda 
|vt	 tasmād eṣaiva pratipat kāryā 
|vu	 <upāsmai gāyatā nara> iti dvitīyā 
|vv	 tad etasmād ahno na yanti 
|vw	 <davidyutatyā ruce>ti tṛtīyā pratyakṣam etasyāhno rūpam 
|vx	 <tam īṃ hinvanty agruva> iti caturthī yābhyuditā pratipat tāṃ ned antarayāmeti /9/


JB 2.10
|va	 <sanā ca soma jeṣi ce>ti daśarcaṃ bhavati 
|vb	 ṛṣayo vā etad ṛddhikāmā upotthānaṃ priyaṃ vāco 'paśyan 
|vc	 <athā no vasyasas kṛdhy athā no vasyasas kṛdhī>ti tenāstuvata 
|vd	 tato vai te sarva evārdhnuvan 
|ve	 sarve haivardhnuvanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsa etena daśarcena stuvate 
|vf	 tasmin ha smāha śaktir virājaṃ geyāṃ <sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi 
śrava> ekaṃ dve trīṇi catvāripañca ṣaṭ saptāṣṭau nava daśa <huṃbhā oi bhūr> iti 
|vg	 tad āhuḥ kṛtrimevaiṣā virāḍ upākāryeva 
|vh	 saṃpadaṃ lobhayati 
|vi	 <om> ity etad evākṣaraṃ geyam iti 
|vj	 etad dha vā idaṃ sarvam akṣaram 
|vk	 yathā sūcyā palāśāni saṃtṛṇṇāni syur evam etenākṣareṇeme lokās saṃtṛṇṇāḥ 
|vl	 daśadhā vā etad atividhyemān kṣarati śatadhemān sahasradhemān 
|vm	 tasmād etad evākṣaraṃ geyam iti paryāso bhavati 
|vn	 yaḥ paryāso kāmas sa na upāpto 'sad iti 
|vo	 tāḥ pañcaviṃśati stotriyās saṃpadyante 
|vp	 pañcaviṃśo vai prajāpatiḥ 
|vq	 prājāpatyaṃ mahāvrataṃ tat tatsalakṣma kriyate /10/


JB 2.11
|va	 atha ha smāhāryakacit sarvam evaitad ahaś caturviṃśaṃ kāryam 
|vb	 ekam evaitat stotraṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ kuryuḥ 
|vc	 abhyāroho vā eṣa ekasya stotrasya yat sarvaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ kurvanti 
|vd	 tathaitat stotram anabhyārūḍhaṃ bhavatīti 
|ve	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyaniḥ kartapatyam ivaitad yan nvāvaikasyai stotriyāyai chidyate 
yad dvābhyāṃ yat tisṛbhyaḥ 
|vf	 tasya nv eva prāyaścittiṃ vindanti vā na vātha kiṃ yad ekādaśabhyaś chidyate 
|vg	 ko tasya prāyaścittiḥ 
|vh	 ekadevatyaṃ vā etad ahaḥ prājāpatyam eva 
|vi	 prajāpatiṃ vāvaitenāhnā pariveviṣati 
|vj	 tasmāt sarvam evaitad ahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ kāryam iti 
|vk	 tasya trīṇi śatāni stotriyā bhavanti dvāṣaṣṭiś ca 
|vl	 tato yāni hi trīṇi śatāni virāṭ sā 
|vm	 atha yā ṣaṣṭir ūdhas tat 
|vn	 atha ye dve stanāv eva tāv etasyaivāhno dohāya /11/


JB 2.12
|va	 <suṣamiddho na ā vahe>ty āprīr ājyaṃ bhavati 
|vb	 yatra ha vai kva cāprīr ājyaṃ prajāpater eva tat 
|vc	 prajāpatim eva tenāprīṇanti 
|vd	 <tā naś śaktaṃ pārthivasye>ti maitrāvaruṇam 
|ve	 tadvad aha bhavati 
|vf	 aniruktam u vai prājāpatyam 
|vg	 prājāpatye 'haṃs tat tatsalakṣma kriyate 
|vh	 <mahaṃ indro ya ojase>ty aindraṃ bhavati 
|vi	 niṣkasya haitan maṇe rūpam 
|vj	 tasmān niṣkaṃ maṇiṃ srajaṃ purastād bibhrati 
|vk	 <tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham> iti rathasya haitad rūpam 
|vl	 tasmāt tam abhihāyaiva tiṣṭhanti 
|vm	 <maha stavāno adriva> iti hastino haitad rūpam 
|vn	 tasmāt taṃ pārśvata ivādhirohanti 
|vo	 tāni vā etāni mahadrūpāṇi saṃpadyante 
|vp	 mahadrūpo vai prajāpatiḥ 
|vq	 prājāpatyaṃ mahāvrataṃ tat tatsalakṣma kriyate 
|vr	 upa hainam etāni rūpāṇy akrītāni tiṣṭhante ya evaṃ veda 
|vs	 <iyaṃ vām asya manmana> ity aindrāgnaṃ bhavati 
|vt	 <indrāgnī>< pūrvyastutir abhrād vṛṣṭir ivājanī>ti 
|vu	 ajanīti vā āhur jātam 
|vv	 jāyata u etenāhnā 
|vw	 yathā ha vā idam āṇḍān nirbhidyerann evam evaitasmād ahno nirbhidyante 
|vx	 <śṛṇutaṃ jaritur havam indrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ> 
|vy	 <īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ> 
|vz	 <mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābhiśastaye> 
|vā	 <mā no rīradhataṃ nide> 
|vab	 iti pāpmana evaiṣopahatiḥ /12/


JB 2.13
|va	 <uccā te jātam andhase>ti mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasyāndhasvatīr gāyatryo 
bhavanti prājāpatyāḥ 
|vb	 prājāpatye 'haṃs tat tatsalakṣma kriyate 
|vc	 tāsu gāyatram uktabrāhmaṇam 
|vd	 athāmahīyavaṃ prājāpatyaṃ sāma prājāpatye 'han kriyate 
|ve	 ahar eva tad rūpeṇa samardhayanti 
|vf	 tenaibhyaḥ samṛddhena svāyāṃ janatāyām ardhukaṃ bhavati 
|vg	 atha dohādohīyaṃ dugdhyā eva etasyāhno dohāya 
|vh	 atha hariśrīrnidhanam 
|vi	 śrīr vai hariśrīrnidhanam 
|vj	 etena vā indras sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śriyam agacchat 
|vk	 śriyam evaitena gacchanti 
|vl	 tā daśa stotriyā gāyatryāṃ saṃpadyante 
|vm	 daśākṣarā virāṭ 
|vn	 annaṃ virāṭ 
|vo	 mukhaṃ gāyatrī chandasām 
|vp	 mukhata evaitad ātmano 'nnādyaṃ dadhate 
|vq	 <punānas soma dhāraye>ty ubhayarūpā bṛhatī bhavati 
|vr	 eṣā ha vā ubhe sāmanī udyayāma 
|vs	 tasmād etāṃ kurvanty eva bṛhatsāmnaḥ kurvanti rathantarasāmnaḥ 
|vt	 <ā pṛcchyena sadhasthena pratnena dharuṇena ca> 
|vu	 <pibācyud indra tvaṃ somam ṛcor garbhe adhyāhitaḥ> 
|vv	 iti yatra ha vai kva caiṣā bṛhatī kriyate na haiva tasyendra īśeta taṃ nāgacchet /13/


JB 2.14
|va	 tāsu rauravaṃ prajñātam agniṣṭomasāma 
|vb	 prajñātam agniṣṭomasāma ned antarayāmeti 
|vc	 athārkapuṣpam annaṃ vā arkaḥ 
|vd	 tasyaitat puṣpaṃ yad āraṇyam 
|ve	 tad dhy araṇye jāyata āraṇyasyaivānnādyasyāvaruddhyai 
|vf	 athābhīśavaṃ tṛptyā eva 
|vg	 tarpayanty evainam etena 
|vh	 atha pañcaviṃśatyakṣaranidhanam āṅgirasam 
|vi	 aṅgiraso vā ṛddhikāmās tapo 'tapyanta 
|vj	 ta etat sāmāpaśyan 
|vk	 tenāstuvata 
|vl	 tato vai te sarva evārdhnuvan 
|vm	 sarve haivardhnuvanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsa etena sāmnā stuvate 
|vn	 tat pañcaviṃśatyakṣaranidhanaṃ bhavati 
|vo	 pañcaviṃśo vai prajāpatiḥ 
|vp	 prājāpatyaṃ mahāvrataṃ tat tatsalakṣma kriyate 
|vq	 atha naudhasaṃ prajñātaṃ brahmasāma 
|vr	 prajñātaṃ brahmasāma ned antarayāmeti 
|vs	 atha pṛśni annaṃ vai pṛśni annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai 
|vt	 atha rauhiṇakam 
|vu	 etena vai prajāpatir ekaśaphānāṃ paśūnāṃ kāmam ārohat 
|vv	 tad yat kāmam ārohat tad rauhiṇakasya rauhiṇakatvam 
|vw	 kāmaṃ paśūnāṃ rohati ya evaṃ veda 
|vx	 yathā ha vā ima āraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā evam ete 'gra ekaśaphāḥ paśava āsuḥ 
|vy	 tān etair eva rauhiṇakasya kiṭkiṭākārair grāmam upānayat 
|vz	 tat trayodaśanidhanaṃ bhavati trayodaśasya māsa upāptyai 
|vā	 tad vā aśītibhis saṃpannam 
|vab	 āśayanty evainam etena 
|vac	 atha dairghaśravasam annaṃ vai dairghaśravasam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai 
|vad	 atha samantam samantāḥ prajāpaśubhir asāmeti 
|vae	 atha yaudhājayaṃ triṇidhanaṃ savanānāṃ kḍptyai 
|vaf	 athauśanam antyaṃ sāma 
|vag	 antyena sāmnāntyaṃ svargaṃ lokam aśnavāmahā iti /14/


JB 2.15
|va	 tad āhus tavaśśāvyam evaitasyāhnaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kāryam iti 
|vb	 tasyaiṣā kalyāṇy eva praśaṃsā na tv evāsmin dvau saṃpādayataḥ 
|vc	 vāmadevyam evety āhuḥ 
|vd	 vāmadevyaṃ hi (?) 
|ve	 tad dha vai pratyakṣaṃ vāmadevyaṃ yad rājanam 
|vf	 tasya prāṇena prastauti 
|vg	 ṛcā vai vāmadevyasya prastauti 
|vh	 prāṇenaitasya <hiṃ hiṃ hiṃ prāṇo 'sad> iti vai hiṃkurvanti 
|vi	 yathā ha vai vayasa āśaya evaṃ rājanasya vāmadevyam 
|vj	 prajāpatir vai pitādityaḥ putraḥ 
|vk	 prajāpatir vāmadevyam ādityo rājanam 
|vl	 tasmād eṣa etayor ābhāvattaraṃ tapati 
|vm	 etad dhy asmāt tejo nirbhinnam 
|vn	 tad vā aśītibhis saṃpannam 
|vo	 ekaikasyāṃ stotriyāyāṃ dve dve aśītyau saṃpadyete 
|vp	 tāḥ pañcāśad aśītayas saṃpadyante 
|vq	 dve ha vā aśītyāv ahaś caiva rātriś ca 
|vr	 tābhyām enam āśayanti 
|vs	 āśayanty evainam etābhyām 
|vt	 tasya yan nidhana pṛṣṭhāny eva tāni /15/


JB 2.16
|va	 vāg iti rathantaram 
|vb	 iḍeti vairūpam 
|vc	 tac chakvaryas tad revatayaḥ 
|vd	 svar iti vairājam 
|ve	 bṛhad iti bṛhat 
|vf	 bhā ity asau vā ādityaḥ 
|vg	 bhā ity etad evāsya nidhanam 
|vh	 etasya salomatām aśnute ya evaṃ veda 
|vi	 tad etat sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhāny abhivadaty etena sāmanidhanena 
|vj	 ta u vai pañca pañcaviṃśās sāmanidhanānāṃ saṃstutānāṃ saṃpadyante 
|vk	 tān u etān nidhanair eva hotānuśaṃsati 
|vl	 tad āhur ātmanāgre pratipadyam atha śīrṣṇā 
|vm	 ātmā vā agre 'tha śira iti 
|vn	 tad u ha tad yathā kartaṃ patet tādṛk tad yat pañcaviṃśād ātmanas trivṛc chiro 'bhi 
pratyavaroheyuḥ 
|vo	 śīrṣṇaiva pratipadyam 
|vp	 sarvā ha vā etad devatā stotraṃ pratyupatiṣṭhanti mayā pratipatsyate mayā mayeti 
|vq	 sa yadi śīrṣṇā pratipadyeta yaiva śiraḥpratipaddevatā bhavati tām eva tenardhnoti 
|vr	 yadi pakṣeṇa yaiva pakṣaupratipaddevatā bhavati tām eva tenardhnoti 
|vs	 yadi pucchena yaiva pucchaṃpratipaddevatā bhavati tām eva tenardhnoti 
|vt	 yady ātmanā yaivātmanaḥpratipaddevatā bhavati tām eva tenardhnoti 
|vu	 antaritā itarā devatā bhavanti 
|vv	 sarvā u ha vai devatāś śīrṣann eveme vai vasavaḥ /16/


JB 2.17
|va	 ime rudrā ima ādityā ime viśve devāḥ 
|vb	 ayam evāyaṃ loka idam antarikṣam ayam asau loka imā diśa śrotram idaṃ 
rathantaram idaṃ vāmadevyam idaṃ bṛhad idaṃ yajñāyajñīyam 
|vc	 tad etac chīrṣṇā pratipadyamānas sarvābhir devatābhis sarvair ebhir lokais sarvais 
sāmabhir anantarāyaṃ pratipadyate 
|vd	 sa yad ito 'nyenāṅgena pratipadyeta yaiva tatpratipaddevatā syāt tām evardhnuyāt 
|ve	 antaritā itarā devatā syuḥ 
|vf	 athaitac chīrṣṇā pratipadyamānas sarvābhir eva devatābhir anantarāyaṃ 
pratipadyate 
|vg	 atho haitad devatānāṃ priyaṃ yac chīrṣṇā pratipadyate sarvā no nāparātsīd iti /17/


JB 2.18
|va	 reto vā etad agre praviśati yad gāyatram 
|vb	 tato 'nyāny aṅgāni vikriyante 
|vc	 prāṇo vā eṣa praviśati yad gāyatram 
|vd	 tam anyāny aṅgāny upasaṃsīdanti 
|ve	 sa imān prāṇān ākāśān abhinirmanthati 
|vf	 prāṇo vai gāyatraḥ 
|vg	 gāyatraṃ śira eva 
|vh	 tadāyatano vai prāṇo yac chiraḥ 
|vi	 tasmāt trivṛtaiva śīrṣṇā pratipadyam atha pañcadaśena pakṣeṇātha 
saptadaśenāthaikaviṃśena pucchenātha pañcaviṃśenātmanā 
|vj	 tad ūrdhvāḥ kīrtim ūrdhvā śriyam ūrdhvā svargaṃ lokaṃ rohanti 
|vk	 atho haiṣāṃ tair eva jyotiṣṭomasya stomaiś śivaiś śāntair etad ahaḥ pariṣṭutaṃ 
bhavati 
|vl	 atho haiṣām eta eva jyotiṣṭomasya stomāś śivāś śāntāḥ parimādbhājanaṃ bhavanti 
/18/


JB 2.19
|va	 tad etat sarvapṛṣṭhaṃ sarvastomam ahaḥ 
|vb	 tad yad etena sāmanidhanena sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhāny abhivadati tena sarvapṛṣṭham 
|vc	 atha yad ete jyotiṣṭomasya stomāś śivāś śāntāḥ parimādbhājanaṃ bhavanti tena 
sarvastomam 
|vd	 saṃpadā haiva triṇavatrayastriṃśau stomāv abhisaṃpadyete 
|ve	 sarvapṛṣṭhena hāsya sarvastomenaitenāhnā stutaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vf	 tena haitenaike 'pi tṛtīyaṃ kṛtvā stuvata ekaṃ vāvedaṃ sāmeti vadantaḥ 
|vg	 teṣāṃ ha teṣām amuṣmin loke naiva śiraś cānyāni cāṅgāni vijñāyante /19/


JB 2.20
|va	 piṇḍāḥ piṇḍā iva hi bhavanty akratāḥ 
|vb	 yathāṅgam eva stotavyam 
|vc	 te haivāmuṣmin loke sāṅgās satanavo 'mṛtās saṃbhavanti 
|vd	 atha haike sakṛd eva śīrṣṇe hiṃkurvanti parāṅ etad yac chira iti vadantaḥ 
|ve	 tris trir itarebhyo 'ṅgebhyaḥ 
|vf	 te trayodaśa hiṃkārās saṃpadyante 
|vg	 evaṃ trayodaśasya māsa upāptir iti 
|vh	 tad u ha śaśvan na tathā 
|vi	 trir eva śīrṣṇe hiṃkurvantas tris trir itarebhyo 'ṅgebhyaḥ 
|vj	 te pañcadaśa hiṃkārās saṃpadyante 
|vk	 pañcadaśo vā indraḥ 
|vl	 aindraṃ mahāvrataṃ tat tatsalakṣma kriyate /20/


JB 2.21
|va	 tad āhur naudhasam evaitasyāhno brahmasāma kāryam iti 
|vb	 tad dha tat pakṣam anuvadati 
|vc	 rathantaram eva śyaitam eva kāryam iti 
|vd	 tad u ha tat pakṣam evānuvadati 
|ve	 bṛhad eva pañcanidhanam eva vāmadevyaṃ kāryam iti 
|vf	 ātmānaṃ haiva tad anuvadati 
|vg	 śrāyantīyam eva kāryam iti na ha vai kiṃ cana śrāyantīyam anuvadati 
|vh	 mahāvaiṣṭambham ava kāryam 
|vi	 tad diṅnidhanaṃ bhavati 
|vj	 diśo vai pṛṣṭhāni 
|vk	 iyam eva prācī dig rathantaram iyaṃ bṛhad iyaṃ vairūpam iyaṃ vairājam amūr 
mahānāmnīr imā revatayaḥ 
|vl	 digbhyo vā etasmā annādyaṃ haranti 
|vm	 digbhyo vā asmā annādyaṃ hriyate ya evaṃ veda 
|vn	 atho haiṣām etenaiva sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhāni brahmasāmavanti bhavanti 
|vo	 tasmād u haitat sāmaitasmād ahno nāntarityam 
|vp	 tad u satobṛhatīṣu bhavaty utkrāntyā evānapabhraṃśāya /21/


JB 2.22
|va	 tad āhur ilāndam evaitasyāhno agniṣṭomasāma kāryam iti 
|vb	 tasyaiṣā kalyāṇy eva praśaṃsā 
|vc	 atiricyate yad vyavacchindyurāmaṇīyaṃ (?) tad yad adaḥ pakṣam 
|vd	 ilāndaṃ tad ārbhavasya pavamānasyānuṣṭubhi kāryaṃ yad abhyuditaṃ tan ned 
antarayāmeti 
|ve	 vāravantīyam eva kāryam iti 
|vf	 tasyaiṣā kalyāṇy eva praśaṃsā 
|vg	 niṣiddham iva tu yāvad dhaiva kṛtvo yajate tāvad bubhūṣati tāvat kāmayate śreyān 
syāṃ śreyān syām iti 
|vh	 tad ārbhavasyaiva pavamānasya gāyatryāṃ kāryaṃ yad abhyuditaṃ tan ned 
antarayāmeti 
|vi	 tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam 
|vj	 yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati 
|vk	 vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam 
|vl	 kuto hi vāg vācam ativadiṣyati 
|vm	 tasmād etasyāhno yajñāyajñīyam evāgniṣṭomasāma kāryam iti 
|vn	 athaitac catustriṃśasaṃmitam anuṣṭubhi kurvanti 
|vo	 trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ 
|vp	 prajāpatiś catustriṃśaḥ 
|vq	 saprajāpatikā evaitena devā ṛdhnuvanti 
|vr	 atha yad ārambhaṇīye 'haṃs trayastriṃśatsaṃmitaṃ bhavati devatā eva 
tenardhnuvanti 
|vs	 athaitena saprajāpatikā evaitena devatā antata ṛddhvāptvottiṣṭhanti /22/


JB 2.23
|va	 tad āhuḥ kāṃ devatāṃ dīkṣamāṇā anuniṣīdanti kām anūttiṣṭhantīti 
|vb	 sa brūyād agniṃ devatānāṃ dīkṣamāṇā anuniṣīdanty ādityam anūttiṣṭhantīti 
|vc	 tasmād dīkṣitān sata āhur āsata iti yady api te śayīrann athottiṣṭheyuḥ 
|vd	 agnir hi devānām āsīnānāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ 
|ve	 agnidevatyā hi tarhi bhavanti 
|vf	 tasmād utthitān sata āhur udasthur iti yady api ta āsīrann atho śayīran 
|vg	 ādityo hi devānām utthitānāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ 
|vh	 ādityadevatyā hi tarhi bhavanti 
|vi	 tad āhuḥ ke bhūtvottiṣṭhantīti 
|vj	 sa brūyān manuṣyā bhūtā dīkṣante devā bhūtvottiṣṭhantīti 
|vk	 ta etad ṛgretasaṃ yajūretasaṃ brahmaṇi yonau reto dadhato yanti 
|vl	 agnāv eva tad āhutībhir abhijuhvato yanti 
|vm	 tasmād dīkṣopasatsu vīva glāyanti 
|vn	 taruṇam iva tarhi reto bhavati 
|vo	 tasmād u strī durhṛdinī vīva glāyati 
|vp	 taruṇam iva hi tarhi reto bhavati 
|vq	 tān stutiśastrais trir vardhayanto 'bhiśṛṇvanto yanti 
|vr	 tasmād garbhā anaśnatas saṃbhavanti /23/


JB 2.24
|va	 ta ṛṅmayā yajurmayās sāmamayā brahmamayā hiraṇmayā amṛtās saṃbhavanti 
|vb	 ṛṅmayo ha vai yajurmayas sāmamayo brahmamayo hiraṇmayo 'mṛtas saṃbhavaty 
ṛṅmayāny asyāsthāni bhavanti ya evaṃ veda 
|vc	 tān udgātā purastāt saṃvatsarasya janayitvā hotre prayacchati 
|vd	 tān hotā sūktais sūte 
|ve	 tat sūktānāṃ sūktatvam 
|vf	 tāñ chastraiḥ praśāsti 
|vg	 tac chastrāṇāṃ śastratvam 
|vh	 tān ukthair utthāpayati 
|vi	 tad ukthānāṃ ukthatvam 
|vj	 tebhya etad devyaṃ madhv aśītibhir annādyaṃ prayacchati 
|vk	 madhu hāsyāsmiṃś ca loke 'muṣmiṃś cānnaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vl	 akṣareṇākṣareṇo hāsmai vidyās sarvān kāmān duhre 
|vm	 tasmāt saṃvatsara eva śasyaṃ saṃvatsare procyam 
|vn	 tasmād brāhmaṇo hato na stāyādbhavati 
|vo	 tasmād retas siktaṃ na stāyādbhavati 
|vp	 tasmād u haivaṃ vidvān na stāyādbhavati 
|vq	 aśītibhir vai devā imān lokān imān adhvana āśnuvata 
|vr	 tad aśītīnām aśītitvam 
|vs	 tisṛbhir evemaṃ lokam āśnuvata tisṛbhir antarikṣaṃ tisṛbhir amuṃ catasṛbhir eva 
diśa āśnuvata catasṛbhir avāntaradeśān ekayāmūm ūrdhvāṃ dvānavāśītayo 'bhavan 
|vt	 nava prāṇāḥ 
|vu	 aśnute prāṇān 
|vv	 saprāṇas saṃbhavati 
|vw	 sarvam āyur eti 
|vx	 nākāmo mriyate /24/


JB 2.25
|va	 athaiṣaudumbarī rājāsandī 
|vb	 tasyai bṛhadrathantare pūrvau pādau vairūpavairāje aparau śākvararaivate anūcyāni 
ṛcaḥ prācīnam ātānā yajūṃṣi tiraścīnaṃ sāmāny āstaraṇaṃ vākovākyam atīrokā śrīr 
upabarhaṇam 
|vc	 tasyai prajāpatiś ca bṛhaspatiś ca pūrvau pādāv adhārayetāṃ somaś ca varuṇaś 
cāparau 
|vd	 tasyām etam ādityam abhyaṣiñcanta 
|ve	 vasavo rājyāya rudrā vairājyāyādityā svārājyāya viśve devās sāmrājyāya marutas 
sārvavaśyāya sādhyāś cāptyāś ca pārameṣṭhyāya 
|vf	 tan na haitāvat kayācana devatayā jitaṃ yāvad ādityena 
|vg	 ye hi sutā devānām āsaṃs ta enam asuvata 
|vh	 tasmin diśo apitvam aicchanta yathā rājani vijitiny apitvam icchanta evam 
|vi	 tā abravīd pradānaṃ me prayacchateti 
|vj	 seyaṃ prācī dik prāyacchan mad udayety ahaś ca satyaṃ ca 
|vk	 mām abhy udayety ūrdhvā dik prāyacchat kṣatraṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca 
|vl	 mām abhy apakrāmeti dakṣiṇā dik prāyacchad annaṃ ca rathaṃ ca 
|vm	 mām abhy apakrāmety udīcī dik prāyacchad rūpaṃ ca varṇaṃ ca 
|vn	 samayā mām ayety antarikṣaṃ prāyacchat prakāśaṃ cāsaṃbādhaṃ ca 
|vo	 mām abhy astam ayeti pratīcī dik prāyacchad ṛtaṃ ca rātriṃ ca 
	 anu mām ātapeti pṛthivī prāyacchat /25/


JB 2.26
|va	 kṣemaṃ ca vimokaṃ ca 
|vb	 atha hāpa śreyasīr menire 
|vc	 tāḥ prati tvā vayam ātapāma iti yātrāṃ ca prayāṃ ca prāyacchan 
|vd	 adbhir ha vā eṣa etad ety apām evāyanena 
|ve	 tāsām etāsām ūrdhvāś chāyāḥ prati hainaṃ tad ātapanti 
|vf	 sa evam etā diśa upāpnoti 
|vg	 asyai prācyai diśa udeti 
|vh	 abhy udetīmām ūrdhvāṃ diśam 
|vi	 ṣaḍ itthaṃ māsa eti ṣaḍ ittham 
|vj	 samayāntarikṣam eti 
|vk	 abhy astam etīmāṃ aparāṃ diśam 
|vl	 anv imāṃ pṛthivīm ātapati 
|vm	 tad yathā patir jāyā anusaṃcared evam evainā eṣa etad anusaṃcarati 
|vn	 sa aikṣatāham evedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvṛṇajā iti 
|vo	 sa vaśam eva diva ādatta kṣatraṃ nakṣatrāṇām ātmānam antarikṣasya rūpaṃ vāyor 
ājñāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ cakṣaḥ paśūnām ūrjam apāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ carathaṃ 
vanaspatīnāṃ śiśnaṃ vayasām arciṣam agner hṛdayaṃ pṛthivyai gandhaṃ 
hiraṇyasya stanayitnuṃ vācas saṅgamaṃ pit.ṛrṇāṃ bhāṃ candramasaḥ 
|vp	 tad yad eteṣāṃ bhūtānām ādatta tad ādityasyādityatvam 
|vq	 sa ya etad evaṃ vedaiṣa evādityo bhūtvaitasyāṃ rājāsandyām āste /26/


JB 2.27
|va	 na ha brūyāt sattram āsiṣya iti 
|vb	 śramiṣyāmīty eva vaktavyam 
|vc	 dve ha vāva devate sattram āsāte prāṇāpānāv eva 
|vd	 tayos so 'bhyārohaḥ 
|ve	 tad yat tāv idaṃ sattrāyete tasmāt tau sattrasadau 
|vf	 tasmād u śramiṣyāmīty eva vaktavyam 
|vg	 tasyaiṣa ślokaḥ 
|vh	 <saptarṣayaḥ pratihitās subhūte> 
|vi	 <sapta paśyanti bahudhā niviṣṭau> 
|vj	 <saptaitaṃ lokam upayanty āpo> 
|vk	 <'svapnajau sattrasadau yatra devā> 
|vl	 iti 
|vm	 <saptarṣayaḥ pratihitās subhūta> iti puruṣo vai subhūtam 
|vn	 ta ime saptarṣayaḥ pratihitāḥ prāṇā eva 
|vo	 <spata paśyanti bahudhā niviṣṭāv> iti bahudhā hy etau niviṣṭau paśyanti yat 
prāṇāpānau 
|vp	 <saptaitaṃ lokam upayanty āpa> itīmā dvayīr āpa imā dvayīr imā ekā imā dvayīr 
avācīḥ 
|vq	 <asvapnajau sattrasadau yatra devā> ity ete eva te devate /sa ya etad evaṃ veda  27/


JB 2.28
|va	 yadi ca sa ha sattram āste yadi ca nātha hāsyāsitam eva sattraṃ bhavati 
|vb	 ya u evaṃ vidvāñ chramam upaparaity ete evāsya devate bhāgās sattram āsāte so 
'nārtas saṃvatsarasyodṛcaṃ gacchati 
|vc	 asāv eva saṃvatsaro yo 'sau tapati 
|vd	 tasya yad bhāti tat saṃvad yan madhye kṛṣṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tat sara ity adhidevatam 
|ve	 athādhyātmam 
|vf	 ayam eva saṃvatsaro yo 'yaṃ cakṣuṣi puruṣaḥ 
|vg	 tasya yac chuklaṃ tat saṃvad yan madhye kṛṣṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tat saraḥ 
|vh	 tasyaiṣa ślokaḥ 
|vi	 <mad evodeti sūryo 'staṃ mad u ca gacchati> 
|vj	 <māṃ sarve devā anvāyattā mām u nātyeti kiṃ cana> 
|vk	 iti 
|vl	 <mad evodeti sūrya> ity evaṃvido ha vāva sūrya udeti 
|vm	 <astaṃ mad u ca gacchatī>ty evaṃvido ha vāvāstam eti 
|vn	 <māṃ sarve devā anvāyattā> ity evaṃvidaṃ ha vāva sarve devā anvāyattāḥ 
|vo	 <mām u nātyeti kiṃ cane>ty evaṃvidaṃ ha vāva na kiṃ canātyeti /28/


JB 2.29
|va	 tad āhuḥ kiṃ saṃvat kiṃ saraṃ kim ayanam iti 
|vb	 sa brūyāt trayy eva vidyā saṃvat 
|vc	 tāṃ hi sarve devās saṃvāntāḥ 
|vd	 ahorātre eva saraḥ 
|ve	 te hīdaṃ sarvaṃ sarataḥ 
|vf	 āditya evāyanam 
|vg	 sa hy eṣu lokeṣv eti 
|vh	 ity adhidevatam 
|vi	 athādhyātmam 
|vj	 annam eva saṃvat 
|vk	 tad dhīdaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvāntam 
|vl	 vāg eva saraḥ 
|vm	 vācā hi puruṣas sarati 
|vn	 prāṇa evāyanam 
|vo	 sa hy asmin sarvasminn eti 
|vp	 sa ya evam etad adhidevataṃ cādhyātmaṃ ca saṃvatsarāyaṇaṃ vedānārta eva 
saṃvatsarasyodṛcaṃ gacchati /tad āhuḥ kathaṃ saṃvatsara ekacchandā bārhato 
bhavatīti  29/


JB 2.30
|va	 ahobhir iti brūyāt 
|vb	 katham ahobhir iti 
|vc	 atirātrāv ārambhaṇīyamahāvratīye ahanī pṛṣṭhyābhiplavāv abhijit traya 
svarasāmānaḥ pratyañcas traya svarasāmāno viśvajid goāyuṣī daśarātro vaiṣuvatam 
eva saptatriṃśam etasmin svarge loke 'dhyūḍham 
|vd	 tasyaiṣa ślokaḥ 
|ve	 <tāṃ viṃśatis saptaśatāni cāhuṣ> 
|vf	 <ṣaṭtriṃśinīṃ bṛhatīṃ kalpamānām> 
|vg	 <sānuṣṭub bhūtvā paśubhis sayonir> 
|vh	 <devān pit.ṛrn dadate manuṣyāṃś ca> 
|vi	 iti 
|vj	 <tāṃ viṃśatis saptaśatāni cāhur> ity ahorātrā eva te 
|vk	 <ṣaṭtriṃśinīṃ bṛhatīṃ kalpamānām> ity evaṃ ha tad ahobhiṣ ṣaṭtriṃśinī bṛhatī 
kalpate 
|vl	 <sānuṣṭub bhūtvā paśubhis sayonir> itīyam eva dig gām āharad iyam aśvam iyam 
ajām iyam avim 
|vm	 anuṣṭubhe vā etasyai satyai diśaś śulkam āharann ity evaṃ ha tat 
|vn	 <><devān pit.ṛrn dadate manuṣyāṃś ce>ti 
|vo	 vāg vā anuṣṭup 
|vp	 vāco vā idaṃ sarvaṃ yatam 
|vq	 evaṃ vai saṃvatsara ekacchandā bārhato bhavatīti /30/


JB 2.31
|va	 ayam eva spṛṣṭyo yo 'yaṃ pavate 
|vb	 etena hīdaṃ sarvaṃ spṛṣṭam 
|vc	 spṛṣṭyo ha vai nāmaiṣaḥ 
|vd	 taṃ pṛṣṭhya iti parokṣam ācakṣate 
|ve	 sarvān kāmān spṛśati ya evaṃ veda 
|vf	 asāv evābhiplavo yo 'sau tapati 
|vg	 eṣa hīdaṃ sarvam abhiplavate 
|vh	 tad āhur yat pṛṣṭhyābhiplavāv ity ācakṣate 'bhiplavam u vai pūrvam upayanti 
|vi	 kathaṃ pṛṣṭhyaḥ pūrva upeto bhavatīti 
|vj	 sa brūyād yad evāyam avaro vāyuḥ pavate para ādityas teneti 
|vk	 atho yat paraṃ santam abhiplavam avaram upayanti vyatiṣaṅgāyānirmārgāya sarvāyuṣṭāyai 
|vl	 tad āhur yac catvāro 'bhiplavasya stomāṣ ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhyasya kathaṃ tat sabhāram iti 
|vm	 sa brūyād yad evaite sadṛśyau devate vāyuś cādityaś ca tena sabhāram iti 
|vn	 atho yad brahmābhiplavaḥ kṣatraṃ pṛṣṭhyas teno eveti /31/


JB 2.32
|va	 tad āhur yad ete pṛṣṭhyasya viṣamā stomās trivṛt pañcadaśas saptadaśa ekaviṃśas 
triṇavas trayastriṃśa iti katham etat samāt samam upetaṃ bhavatīti 
|vb	 sa brūyād brahma vai trivṛt 
|vc	 kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ 
|vd	 brahma vai kṣatrāj jyāyaḥ 
|ve	 tena samāt samam upetaṃ bhavati 
|vf	 viṭ saptadaśaḥ 
|vg	 kṣatram u vai viśo jyāyaḥ 
|vh	 tena samāt samam upetaṃ bhavati 
|vi	 ekaviṃśaṃ stomam anu śūdraḥ 
|vj	 vaiśyo vai śūdrāj jyāyān 
|vk	 tena samāt samam upetaṃ bhavati 
|vl	 triṇavaṃ stomam anu grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ 
|vm	 śūdro vai grāmyebhyaḥ paśubhya śreyān 
|vn	 attā hi sa teṣām 
|vo	 tena samāt samam upetaṃ bhavati 
|vp	 trayatriṃśaṃ stomam anv āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ 
|vq	 grāmyā vai paśava āraṇyebhyaḥ paśubhya śreyāṃsaḥ 
|vr	 bibhyata itare caranty adhigantetareṣāṃ hantā 
|vs	 tena samāt samam upetaṃ bhavati 
|vt	 tad āhuḥ kasmād ekarūpo 'bhiplavo dvirūpaḥ pṛṣṭhyas samāna eva san vyūḍhaś ca 
samūḍhaś ceti 
|vu	 sa brūyād yasmād idaṃ brahma brahmaiva 
|vv	 atha yasmād u kṣatriyas san brāhmaṇo bhavati tasmād ekarūpo 'bhiplavo dvirūpaḥ 
pṛṣṭhya iti 
|vw	 tad dhaitad eke 'bhiplavasya ṣaṣṭham ahar ukthyaṃ kurvanty evaṃ sabhāram iti 
|vx	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir mohayanti te 'bhiplavaṃ ye tathā kurvanti 
|vy	 abrahma tarhi bhavati 
|vz	 tasmāt tathā na kāryam iti 
|vā	 atha haike pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaṣṭhād ahno dvipada uddharanty evaṃ sabhāram iti 
|vab	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyani svarga eṣa loko yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ 
|vac	 yajamāna eṣa nidānena yad dvipadaḥ 
|vad	 tam āyatanāc cyāvayanti 
|vae	 sa ya enāṃs tathā cakruṣo brūyād āyatanād vā cyoṣyante 'smād vā lokād iti tathā 
haiva syuḥ 
|vaf	 tasmāt tathā na kāryam iti /32/


JB 2.33
|va	 tad āhur yad idaṃ prāyaṇīyam ahas trivṛd ācakṣate prāyaṇīyam ity adaś 
caturviṃśaṃ katham etat trivṛtā prayataṃ bhavatīti 
|vb	 sa brūyād yad evaite catvāriṃśat trivṛtas saṃpadyante tena trivṛtā prayataṃ 
bhavatīti 
|vc	 atho yac caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī teno eveti 
|vd	 tad āhuḥ katham etad vaiṣuvatīyam ahaś chandomyaṃ bhavatīti 
|ve	 sa brūyād yāvanti saptānāṃ caturuttarāṇāṃ chandasām akṣarāṇi tāvaty etasyāhna 
stotriyāḥ 
|vf	 tena chandomyaṃ bhavatīti 
|vg	 tad āhur yad upariṣṭād viṣuvataś chandomān upayanti kathaṃ purastād viṣuvataś 
chandomā upetā bhavantīti 
|vh	 sa brūyād ya evaiṣa ārambhaṇīyasyāhnaś caturviṃśaś chāndomikastomas tena 
purastād viṣuvataś chandomā upetā bhavantīti 
|vi	 atho yad eva pṛṣṭhyasya dve dve ahanī samaste chandomās saṃpadyante teno eveti 
/33/


JB 2.34
|va	 tad āhur yat ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ purastād viṣuvataḥ pṛṣṭhyāny upayanti viṣvajiti saptamam 
upariṣṭāt kathaṃ tat sabhāram iti 
|vb	 sa brūyād yad vā arvācīnaṃ viṣuvatas tad ayaṃ loko yad ūrdhvaṃ viṣuvatas tad 
asau lokaḥ 
|vc	 āsanna iva vā ayaṃ lokaḥ 
|vd	 prarikta ivāsāv anyaḥ 
|ve	 dvitīyo hy ayaṃ lokaḥ 
|vf	 tad yad viśvajiti saptamam upariṣṭāt pṛṣṭhyāny upayanty evaṃ sabhāram iti 
|vg	 atho ya evam viśvajit pṛṣṭhamayam eva 
|vh	 gaur vai rathataram aśvo bṛhad ajā vairūpam avir vairājaṃ vrīhayaś śakvaryo yavā 
revatayaḥ 
|vi	 sa eṣa rathas saṃsakto yat pṛṣṭhāni 
|vj	 tasyaiṣo 'kṣo yad gāyatrīṣu bṛhad agniṣṭomasāma bhavaty etasya 
rathasyānapavyāthāya 
|vk	 atha ya etan nirhṛtapṛṣṭham upayanti viṣaktarathaṃ te viśvajitaṃ śūnyam upayanti 
|vl	 te na kiṃ cana vyaśnuvate 
|vm	 tasmāt pṛṣṭhamaya eva viśvajit kārya iti /34/


JB 2.35
|va	 tad dhaitad eke svarasāmnāṃ svarāṇy eva pṛṣṭhāni kurvanti 
|vb	 pṛṣṭhena vā ahar ākhyāyate svarasāmāna ity eta ākhyāyante 
|vc	 tasmāt svarasāmnāṃ svarāṇy eva pṛṣṭhāni kāryāṇīti 
|vd	 te cet svarāṇi pṛṣṭhāni kuryur yāni ṣṭaṃ (?) bhavanti tāny ekabṛhatīṣu kuryuḥ 
|ve	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir vayaṃ vāva pratyakṣaṃ svarāṇi pṛṣṭhāni kurmo ye 
bṛhadrathantare kurmaḥ 
|vf	 idaṃ vai rathantaram ado bṛhat 
|vg	 ābhyām u vai lokābhyām idaṃ sarvaṃ spṛtam 
|vh	 tasmād bṛhadrathantare eva pṛṣṭhe kārye iti 
|vi	 atho haite vicchinnān svarasāmna upayanti ye trīṇy upayanti 
|vj	 sarvāṇy eva kāryāṇi 
|vk	 tathā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyām ahas tāyate 
|vl	 evaṃ saṃgṛhītā svarasāmāno bhavanty avicchinnātho pāpavasyasasya vyāvṛttyā iti 
/tad dhaitad eke viṣuvato bṛhatīṣv eva bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ kurvanti  35/


JB 2.36
|va	 bārhato viṣuvān bārhato vāsāv ādityaḥ 
|vb	 bṛhatyām eṣa etad adhyūḍhas tapati 
|vc	 tasmād bṛhatīṣv eva bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ kāryam iti 
|vd	 atha haike bṛhatīṣv eva divākīrtyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kurvanti 
|ve	 bṛhatyāyatanāni pṛṣṭhāni 
|vf	 idaṃ vā antarikṣaṃ bṛhatī 
|vg	 tasyām ayaṃ vāyur antaḥ pavate 
|vh	 tat pṛṣṭhaṃ tasyā u eva yad dvādaśākṣaraṃ padaṃ tena jagatīṣu kṛtaṃ bhavati 
|vi	 evaṃ tṛtīyasavanam ayātayāma kriyata iti 
|vj	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir jāgato viṣuvān 
|vk	 jāgatam etat sāma 
|vl	 jāgato 'sāv ādityaḥ 
|vm	 yadā hy eṣa udety atha jagad etasyaiva prayāṇam anu praiti 
|vn	 tasmāj jagatīṣv eva divākīrtyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kāryam iti 
|vo	 tato yās tisro jagatyaś catasras tā bṛhatyaḥ 
|vp	 tena bṛhatīṣu kṛtaṃ bhavati 
|vq	 tās saṃstutā aṣṭāviṃśatir bṛhatyas saṃpadyante 
|vr	 teno eva bṛhaty antaritā bhavati 
|vs	 atho haitat prāṇasyaiva reto nirmitaṃ yad divākīrtyam 
|vt	 prajananaṃ jagatī 
|vu	 so 'sāv ādityaḥ 
|vv	 tad yaj jagatīṣu divākīrtyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kurvanti svenaivainaṃ tad āyatanena 
samardhayanti 
|vw	 tenaibhyaḥ samṛddhena svāyāṃ janatāyām ardhukaṃ bhavati /36/


JB 2.37
|va	 tad etat pṛcchanti kiṃ tad divākīrtye 'han kriyate yena prajāḥ prajanayati yena ca 
prajā dādhārayati 
|vb	 sa brūyāt prāṇasyaiva reto nirmitaṃ yad divākīrtyam 
|vc	 prajananaṃ jagatī 
|vd	 tena prajāḥ prajanayati 
|ve	 atha yat prāṇo bhūtvā parāṇi cāvarāṇi cāhāni dādharti teno eva prajā dādhārayati 
|vf	 prāṇa eva divākīrtyam 
|vg	 cakṣuṣī bhrājābhrāje

JB 2.50
|va	 yadā vai tūṣṇīm āste prāṇam eva vāg apyeti

iṣṭaṃ bhavati 
|vg	 sa eṣa samānaprāyaṇas samānasaṃbandhanas saṃvatsaraḥ

|vi	 sa eṣa saṃvatsaro 'gniṣṭomān evābhisaṃpadyate

|vs	 agniṣṭomo 'bhijit 
|vt	 nava svarasāmnām atiyanti 
|vu	 tad amūni trīṇy upadadhāti

|vw	 agniṣṭomo viṣuvān 
|vx	 pratīcāṃ svarasāmnāṃ navātiyanti

|vā	 so 'gniṣṭomaḥ 
|vab	 ekasya trīṇi 
|vac	 tāny eṣu navasūpadadhāti 
|vad	 so 'gniṣṭomaḥ 
|vae	 agniṣṭomo viśvajit 
|vaf	 goāyuṣoṣ ṣaḍ atiyanti

|vah	 agniṣṭomo mahāvratīyam ahaḥ 
|vai	 ṣaḍ atirātrasyātiyanti 
|vaj	 tad amūni ṣaḍ upadadhāti 
|vak	 so 'gniṣṭomaḥ 
|val	 dvādaśakṛtvaṣ ṣoḍaśinam upayanti 
|vam	 so 'gniṣṭomaḥ 
|van	 yady u vā atirātre ṣoḍaśinam upayanti mohayanty amūṃ virājas saṃpadam 
|vao	 atīmām agniṣṭomasaṃpadaṃ ricyate 
|vap	 sa ha so 'nidhāno vajro hinasti 
|vaq	 atha vā anidhāno vajraḥ 
|var	 sa eṣa samānaprāyaṇas samānasaṃbandhanas saṃvatsaraḥ

JB 2.51
|va	 dvayā ha vai pūrva ṛtava āsuḥ prāṇartavo devartavaḥ 
|vb	 athema etarhy ṛtava eva 
|vc	 prāṇa eva vasanta āsa 
|vd	 vāg grīṣmaḥ 
|ve	 cakṣur varṣāḥ 
|vf	 ārdram iva vai cakṣur ārdrā iva varṣāḥ 
|vg	 śrotraṃ śarat 
|vh	 mano hemantaḥ 
|vi	 yā imāḥ puruṣa āpas sa śiśiraḥ 
|vj	 atha devartavaḥ 
|vk	 vāyur eva vasanta āsa 
|vl	 agnir grīṣmaḥ 
|vm	 parjanyo varṣāḥ 
|vn	 ādityaś śarat 
|vo	 candramā hemantaḥ 
|vp	 yā amūr divyā āpas sa śiśiraḥ 
|vq	 sa yas sa prāṇo vasanta āsa yo vāyur vasantas so 'yam etarhi vasantaḥ 
|vr	 atha yā vāg grīṣma āsa yo 'gnir grīṣmas so 'yam etarhi grīṣmaḥ 
|vs	 atha yaś cakṣur varṣā āsur yāḥ parjanyo varṣās tā imā etarhi varṣāḥ 
|vt	 atha yac chrotraṃ śarad āsa ya ādityaś śarat seyam etarhi śarat 
|vu	 atha yan mano hemanta āsa yaś candramā hemantas so 'yam etarhi hemantaḥ 
|vv	 atha yā imāḥ puruṣa āpaś śiśira āsur yā amūr divyā āpas sa śiśiras so 'yam etarhi 
śiśiraḥ /51/


JB 2.52

JB 2.53
|va	 keśī ha dārbhyo darbhaparṇayor didīkṣe

JB 2.54
|va	 atha hetara uvāca 
|vb	 brahmaṇe dadad brūyād brahman manas te dadāni tad anena niṣkrīṇāni brahmann 
idaṃ dadānīti yad dāsyan syāt 
|vc	 sa yan mano dadāti candramā vai manaś candramasam evāsmai tad dadāti 
|vd	 tad yāvac candramā na kṣīyate tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|ve	 hotre dadad brūyāt dhotar vācaṃ te dadāni tām anena niṣkrīṇāni hotar idam dadānīti 
yad dāsyan syāt 
|vf	 sa yad vācaṃ dadāty agnir vai vāg agnim evāsmai tad dadāti 
|vg	 tad yāvad agnir na kṣīyate tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vh	 adhvaryave dadad brūyād adhvaryo prāṇaṃ te dadāni tam anena niṣkrīṇāny 
adhvaryo idaṃ dadānīti yad dāsyan syāt 
|vi	 sa yat prāṇaṃ dadāti vāyur vai prāṇo vāyum evāsmai tad dadāti 
|vj	 tad yāvad vāyur na kṣīyate tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vk	 udgātre dadad brūyād udgātaś cakṣus te dadāni tad anena niṣkrīṇāny udgātar idaṃ 
dadānīti yad dāsyan syāt 
|vl	 sa yac cakṣur dadāty ādityo vai cakṣur ādityam evāsmai tad dadāti 
|vm	 tad yāvad ādityo na kṣīyate tāvad asya tad sattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vn	 sadasyāya dadad brūyāt sasyātmānaṃ te dadāni tam anena niṣkrīṇāni sadasyedaṃ 
dadānīti yad dāsya syāt 
|vo	 sa yad ātmānaṃ dadāty ākāśo vā ātmākāśam evāsmai tad dadāti 
|vp	 tad yāvad ākāśo na kṣīyate tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vq	 hotrakebhyo dadad brūyād dhotrakā śrotraṃ vo dadāni tad anena niṣkrīṇāni 
hotrakā idaṃ dadānīti yad dāsyan syāt 
|vr	 sa yac chrotraṃ dadāti diśo vai śrotraṃ diśa evaibhyas tad dadāti 
|vs	 tad yāvad diśo na kṣīyante tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vt	 prasarpakebhyo dadad brūyāt prasarpakā lomāni vo dadāni tāny anena niṣkrīṇāni 
prasarpakā idaṃ dadānīti yad dāsyan syāt

tad dadāti 
|vv	 tad yāvad oṣadhivanaspatayo na kṣīyante tāvad asya tad dattaṃ na kṣīyate 
|vw	 saiṣeṣṭāpūrtasyākṣitiḥ 
|vx	 sa ya evam etām iṣṭāpūrtasyākṣitiṃ veda na hāsyeṣṭāpūrtaṃ kṣīyate 
|vy	 tad u vā āhur vāg vāva dīkṣito vāg dīkṣā vāg idaṃ sarvaṃ kṣiyati 
|vz	 vāci vāvedaṃ sarvaṃ kṣitam iti vāva tau tat saṃprocāte 
|vā	 tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanī <rathantareṇa dīkṣe vāmadevyena dīkṣe bṛhatā dīkṣa> ity 
eva dīkṣeta

|vac	 saiṣā dīkṣāyai yuktiś ca vimuktiś ca 
|vad	 sa ya evam etāṃ dīkṣāyai yuktiṃ ca vimuktiṃ ca veda vasīyān eva bhavati /54/


JB 2.55
|va	 hṛtsvāśayā āllakeyo dantālasya dhaumyasyāntevāsy āsa

JB 2.56
|va	 sa ha tathaiva palyayamānas somaśuṣmaṃ sātyayajñim ājagāma

|vg	 sa ha vai svarāḍ yatrānyasya lokaṃ nābhidhyāyati 
|vh	 tam evaitena jayati 
|vi	 tasya daśa trivṛnti stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vj	 tās tisro virājaḥ 
|vk	 pañcadaśaṃ ca saptadaśaṃ ca dve 
|vl	 so 'nuṣṭup 
|vm	 eṣo ha vai chandasāṃ svārājyaṃ lokam ānaśe yad anuṣṭup 
|vn	 prajāpatir vā anuṣṭup 
|vo	 prajāpatir vai svārājyam 
|vp	 annam u vai virāṭ 
|vq	 virājy eva tad annādye pratiṣṭhāya svārājyaṃ lokam agacchan 
|vr	 virājy eva tad annādye pratiṣṭhāya svārājyaṃ lokaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda 
|vs	 tasya bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati 
|vt	 ado vai bṛhat 
|vu	 ado vai svārājyam 
|vv	 amum evaitena svārājyaṃ lokam agacchan 
|vw	 amum evaitena svārājyaṃ lokaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda 
|vx	 tasy<endus samudram urviyā vibhātī>ty etad ādiṣṭasāmārbhave pavamāne na 
bhavatīti divas sāmaikāravad bhavati 
|vy	 arvāṅ iva hy asau lokaḥ 
|vz	 stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti 
|vā	 atho yad ekāravad bhavati svargāl lokān net parāñco 'tipadyāmahā iti /86/


JB 2.87
|va	 athaiṣa ṛṣabhaḥ 
|vb	 indro vā akāmayata ṛṣabhas sarvāsāṃ prajānāṃ syām ṛṣabhatāṃ gaccheyam iti 
|vc	 sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|vd	 tam āharat 
|ve	 tenāyajata 
|vf	 tato vai sa ṛṣabhas sarvāsāṃ prajānām abhavad ṛṣabhatām agacchat 
|vg	 ṛṣabha eva svānāṃ prajānāṃ bhavaty ṛṣabhatāṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda 
|vh	 tac chrīr vā ṛṣabhaḥ 
|vi	 śriyaṃ vai sa tad agacchat 
|vj	 ṛṣabho vai rājā manuṣyāṇām 
|vk	 ṛṣabha ṛṣabhaḥ paśūnām 
|vl	 ṛṣabho 'śvavṛṣo vaḍavānām 
|vm	 ṛṣabho basto 'jānām 
|vn	 ṛṣabho vṛṣṇir avīnām 
|vo	 ṛṣabhaḥ kṛṣṇa eṇīnām 
|vp	 ṛṣabha ṛṣyo rohitām 
|vq	 ete ha vā āsāṇ śriyaḥ 
|vr	 śriyaṃ ha gacchati ya evaṃ veda 
|vs	 sa pañcadaśo bhavati 
|vt	 vajro vai pañcadaśaḥ 
|vu	 vajra indraḥ 
|vv	 aindra eṣa yajñas tat tatsalakṣma kriyate 
|vw	 tasyaikaviṃśo mādhyaṃdino bhavati 
|vx	 sā hāsya kakup 
|vy	 ya u ha vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ śreṣṭhās te kakubhaḥ 
|vz	 agnir vā asya lokasya kakub vāyur antarikṣasya ādityo divaḥ 
|vā	 kakubhām eko bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vab	 tasya bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati 
|vac	 indro vai bṛhat 
|vad	 śrīḥ pṛṣṭhāni 
|vae	 indram eva tac chriyā samardhayanti 
|vaf	 tasya ṛṣabhaḥ pāvamāna ṛṣabho vaidanvata ity ete ādiṣṭasāmanī pavamānayor 
bhavataḥ 
|vag	 stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti /87/


JB 2.88
|va	 athaiṣa vyomā 
|vb	 devā vā akāmayanta vyoma syāma vyomānaṃ lokaṃ gacchemeti 
|vc	 ta etaṃ yajñam apaśyan 
|vd	 tam āharan 
|ve	 tenāyajanta 
|vf	 tato vai te vyomāsan vyomānaṃ lokam agacchan 
|vg	 vyomā haiva bhavati vyomānaṃ lokaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda 
|vh	 sa ha vai vyomā yatrānyasya lokaṃ nābhidhyāyati 
|vi	 tam evaitena jayati 
|vj	 saptadaśo bhavati 
|vk	 prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ 
|vl	 prajāpatir vai vyomā 
|vm	 vyomnā vyomāno 'sāma vyomnā vyomānaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vn	 tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ 
|vo	 na ha vā etayor anyatarad vyoma 
|vp	 ubhe ha vā ete vyoma 
|vq	 vyomnā vyomāno 'sāma vyomnā vyomānaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vr	 tasyaikaviṃśa ārbhavaḥ pavamāno bhavaty agniṣṭomasāma vā 
|vs	 dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ 
|vt	 eṣa u ha vai vyomā ye 'rvāñcaḥ prajāpater devās teṣāṃ 
|vu	 vyomnā vyomāno 'sāma vyomnā vyomānaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vv	 tasy<ārko devānāṃ parame vyoman arkasya devāḥ parame viyomann> ity ete 
ādiṣṭasāmanī pavamānayor bhavataḥ 
|vw	 stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti /88/


JB 2.89
|va	 athaitāv udbhidvalabhidau 
|vb	 prajanankāmo haitābhyāṃ yajeta 
|vc	 trivṛtpañcadaśau stomau bhavatas saptisaptadaśāḥ 
|vd	 ūnātiriktau mithunau prajananī 
|ve	 ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya 
|vf	 ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante 
|vg	 tat tat prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vh	 tasmād ubhābhyāṃ prajananakāmo yajeta 
|vi	 atho āhur brahmavarcasakāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti 
|vj	 ṣaḍ vā etayor anyataro gāyatrīr abhisaṃpadyate ṣaḍ anyataraḥ 
|vk	 brahma vai gāyatrī 
|vl	 gāyatrīm etau yajñāv abhisaṃpannau 
|vm	 tasmād ubhābhyāṃ brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta 
|vn	 atho āhur āyuṣkāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti 
|vo	 prāṇo vai gāyatrī 
|vp	 gāyatrīm etau yajñāv abhisaṃpannau 
|vq	 tasmād ubhābhyām āyuṣkāmo yajeta 
|vr	 atho āhus tejaskāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti 
|vs	 tejo vai gāyatrī 
|vt	 gāyatrīm eva tau yajñāv abhisaṃpannau 
|vu	 tasmād ubhābhyāṃ tejaskāmo yajeta 
|vv	 atho āhu svargakāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti 
|vw	 yā vai ṣaḍ gāyatryaś catasras tā bṛhatyaḥ 
|vx	 bṛhatī vai svargaṃ lokam ānaśe 
|vy	 tasmād ubhābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta 
|vz	 atho āhuḥ paśukāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti 
|vā	 yā vai ṣaḍ gāyatryas tisras tā jagatyaḥ 
|vab	 paśavo jagatī 
|vac	 tasmād ubhābhyāṃ paśukāmo yajeta /89/


JB 2.90
|va	 te devā etāv udbhidvalabhidāv apaśyan 
|vb	 tābhyāṃ enā abhiprā[dhā]vayan 
|vc	 te valabhidaiva valam abhindan 
|vd	 udbhidā gā udasṛjanta 
|ve	 sa vā eṣa trivṛtpañcadaśo valabhid bhavati rathantarsāmotsedhabrahmasāmā 
|vf	 athaiṣa udbhit saptisaptadaśo bhavati bṛhatsāmā niṣedhabrahmasāmā 
|vg	 tad yathā ha vai mayūkho vā tīkṣṇaś śaṅkur vaivam eṣa yat trivṛt stomaḥ 
|vh	 tad yathā mayūkhena vā tīkṣṇenābhinidhāya śaṅkunā vā kūṭenābhihanyād evam 
evaitena trivṛtā stomena valam abhinidhāya pañcadaśena vajreṇa vyāsuḥ 
|vi	 atho āhur agnir evaiṣa yat trivṛt stomaḥ 
|vj	 vajra eṣa yat pañcadaśaḥ 
|vk	 tad yathāgnināśmānam abhyoṣya taṃ kūṭena bhindyād evam evaitena trivṛtāgninā 
stomena valam abhyoṣya pañcadaśena vajreṇa vyāsur iti 
|vl	 tā hāntara eva tasthur ayanam avindamānāḥ 
|vm	 tā hotsedhenaivotsiṣidhuḥ 
|vn	 athaiṣa udbhit saptisaptadaśo bhavati 
|vo	 tato yāḥ sapta ta eva saptatayāḥ paśavo 'tha yās saptadaśa sa eva saptadaśaḥ 
prajāpatiḥ 
|vp	 tāḥ pitaram eva prajāpatiṃ paśyantīḥ pratimodamānā udeyuḥ 
|vq	 tā hodetya mahad evābhi visasṛjire 
|vr	 tāsāṃ ha devāḥ parāvāpād bibhayāṃ cakruḥ 
|vs	 tā hotsedhenaivotsidhya niṣedhena niṣidhyātman dadhire 
|vt	 sa yaḥ paśukāma syāt sa etābhyāṃ yajeta 
|vu	 valabhidaiva valaṃ bhinatty udbhidā gā utsṛjate 
|vv	 utsedhenaivainā utsidhya niṣedhena niṣidhyātman dhatte ava paśūn runddhe 
bahupaśur bhavati /90/


JB 2.91
|va	 athaitau satrājitpṛtanājitau 
|vb	 devāsurā vai saṃvatsare prajāpatāv aspardhantaiṣu ca lokeṣu 
|vc	 te devā akāmayanta jayema pṛtanām iti 
|vd	 ta etaṃ pṛtanājitaṃ yajñam apaśyan 
|ve	 tam āharan 
|vf	 tenāyajanta 
|vg	 tato vai te tāṃ pṛtanām ajayan 
|vh	 yat pṛtanām ajayaṃs tat pṛtanājitaḥ pṛtanājittvam 
|vi	 jayati pṛtanāṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ ya evaṃ veda 
|vj	 sa caturviṃśo bhavati 
|vk	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vl	 saṃvatsarād evaināṃs tad ajayan 
|vm	 tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati 
|vn	 idaṃ vai rathantaram 
|vo	 asmād evaināṃs tal lokād ajayan 
|vp	 tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vq	 dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vr	 māsaśa evaināṃs tat saṃvatsarād ajayan 
|vs	 tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti 
|vt	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vu	 ardhamāsaśa evaināṃs tat saṃvatsarād ajayan /91/


JB 2.92
|va	 te jitāḥ pañcaviṃśam eva pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpadyantāmuṃ ca lokam 
|vb	 tān akāmayantāta enān satrā jayemeti 
|vc	 ta etaṃ satrājitaṃ yajñam apaśyan 
|vd	 tam āharan 
|ve	 tenāyajanta 
|vf	 tat enān satrājayan 
|vg	 yat satrājayaṃs tat satrājitas satrājittvam 
|vh	 satrā dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda 
|vi	 sa pañcaviṃśo bhavati 
|vj	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vk	 prajāpatiḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ 
|vl	 saṃvatsarād evaināṃs tat prajāpater ajayan 
|vm	 tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vn	 dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vo	 māsaśa evaināṃs tat saṃvatsarād ajayan 
|vp	 tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti 
|vq	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vr	 abhipūrvam evaināṃs tad ardhamāsaśas saṃvatsarād ajayan 
|vs	 tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ 
|vt	 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda /92/


JB 2.93
|va	 atho āhuḥ prajākāma eva prajāpatir etaṃ pṛtanājitaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|vb	 tam āharat 
|vc	 tenāyajateti 
|vd	 tasya dve aṣṭāśītiśate stotriyā bhavanti 
|ve	 tan nyūnam 
|vf	 nyūnāt prajananam 
|vg	 dve hi te striyā ūne yataḥ sā prajāyate 
|vh	 tat tat prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vi	 sa caturviṃśo bhavati 
|vj	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vk	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vl	 tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vm	 dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vn	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam 
|vo	 tat tat prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vp	 tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti 
|vq	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vr	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam 
|vs	 tat tad abhipūrvaṃ prajananaṃ kriyate 
|vt	 pra prajayā paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda 
|vu	 tāḥ prajanyākāmayatānnavatīr ma imāḥ prajā syur iti 
|vv	 sa etaṃ satrājitaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|vw	 tam āharat 
|vx	 tenāyajata 
|vy	 sa pañcaviṃśo bhavati 
|vz	 caturviṃśatyardhamāso vai saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vā	 annādyaṃ pañcaviṃśī 
|vab	 annādyam evābhyas tat pañcaviṃśyā prāyacchat 
|vac	 tasya trīṇi śatāni stotryā bhavanti 
|vad	 sā virāṭ 
|vae	 annaṃ virāṭ etad evābhyas tad annādyaṃ prāyacchat 
|vaf	 tā asyānnavatīḥ prajā abhavan 
|vag	 sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahubhiḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeyānnāvatīr ma imāḥ prajā syur 
iti sa etābhyāṃ yajeta 
|vah	 bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate 'nnavatīr asya prajā bhavanti /93/


JB 2.94
|va	 athaiṣa virāṭsvarājau 
|vb	 bhrātarāv etena yajñena yajeyātām 
|vc	 yau kāmayeyātāṃ rājyaṃ nāv anyataro gacchet svārājyam anyatara iti sa vā eṣa 
virājaṃ cānuṣṭubhaṃ cābhisaṃpadyate 
|vd	 etad dha vai rājyaṃ yad virāṭ 
|ve	 athaitat svārājyaṃ yad anuṣṭup 
|vf	 virājaiva kanīyān rājyaṃ gacchati anuṣṭubhā jyāyān svārājyaṃ lokam 
|vg	 tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ 
|vh	 etad dha vai rājyaṃ yad rathantaram 
|vi	 athaitat svārājyaṃ yad bṛhat 
|vj	 rathantareṇaiva kanīyān rājyaṃ gacchati 
|vk	 bṛhatā jyāyān svarājyaṃ lokam 
|vl	 tasya trīṇi trivṛnti stotrāṇi bhavanti trīṇi pañcadaśāni trīṇi saptadaśāni trīṇy 
ekaviṃśāni 
|vm	 trivṛdbhir eva kanīyān rājyaṃ gacchati pañcadaśair jyāyān svārājyaṃ lokam 
|vn	 saptadaśair eva kanīyān rājyaṃ gacchaty ekaviṃśair jyāyān svārājyaṃ lokam /94/


JB 2.95
|va	 tad āhur bhūtasyaivaiṣa yajño na bubhūṣato 'prajananī stomo virājaṃ cānuṣṭubhaṃ 
cābhisaṃpadyate 
|vb	 saṃpannam iva vā etac chandaḥ pūrṇam iva prajananaṃ yad virāṭ 
|vc	 anta u vā eṣa chandasāṃ yad anuṣṭub iti 
|vd	 tad u vā āhur ubhayor evaiṣa yajño bhūtasya ca bubhūṣataś ceti 
|ve	 tasyaite trivṛtpañcadaśā stomā bhavanti saptadaśaikaviṃśā ūnātiriktā mithunāḥ 
prajanayaḥ 
|vf	 ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya 
|vg	 ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante 
|vh	 trivṛc ca pañcadaśaś ca tan mithunaṃ prajananam 
|vi	 saptadaśaś caikaviṃśaś ca tan mithunaṃ prajananam 
|vj	 tad yan mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti 
|vk	 atho yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ 
prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan 
mā prajanayād iti 
|vl	 anena hatvāpa prajananatamo yad virājam abhisaṃpadyate 
|vm	 annaṃ vai virāṭ 
|vn	 aśitād vai retas sicyate 
|vo	 retasaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante 
|vp	 atho yad anuṣṭubham abhisaṃpadyata ānuṣṭubho vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatiḥ 
prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti /95/


JB 2.96
|va	 tasya <yuvaṃ hi stha svaḥpatī> ity eṣo pratipat kāryā 
|vb	 eṣā vai dvayos saṃyajamānayoḥ pratipat 
|vc	 tad u vā āhuḥ <pavasva vāco agriya upāsmai gāyatā nara> ity ete eva pratipadau 
kārye 
|vd	 ete vāva dvayoḥ saṃyajamānayoḥ pratipadau 
|ve	 atho ubhe hy atra sāmanī kriyete 
|vf	 tasmād ete eva pratipadau kārye iti 
|vg	 tasminn etāni sāmāny avakalpayanti gauṣūktāśvasūkte hāviṣmatahāviṣkṛte 
|vh	 ye dve dve sāmanī yāni dvayos saṃyajamānayos sāmāni tāni 
|vi	 tasya virāṭsvarājam ārbhavasya pavamānasyānuṣṭubhi kurvanti 
|vj	 virāṭ svarājo hy eṣa yajñaḥ 
|vk	 stomam eva samardhayanti /96/


JB 2.97
|va	 athaiṣa jyeṣṭhayajñaḥ 
|vb	 yo jyaiṣṭhyakāma syāt sa etena yajeta 
|vc	 sa vā eṣo 'ṣṭāv ekaviṃśān abhisaṃpadyate 
|vd	 dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ 
|ve	 eṣa u ha vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vf	 sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa māgraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti 
|vg	 tasya saptadaśāḥ pavamānā bhavanti 
|vh	 prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ 
|vi	 prajāpatir vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vj	 so yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa māgraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti 
|vk	 tasyottarāvanti stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vl	 uttarāvatīm evainaṃ tac chriyam uttarāvantaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti 
|vm	 tasya bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati 
|vn	 śrīr vai bṛhaj jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vo	 ado vai bṛhad ado vai jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vp	 tad enaṃ tac chriyām eva madhyato jyaiṣṭhye pratiṣṭhāpayanti 
|vq	 tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti 
|vr	 dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vs	 saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vt	 so yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa māgraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti 
|vu	 tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti 
|vv	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vw	 saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam 
|vx	 so yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa māgraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti 
|vy	 sa yo jyeṣṭho jyaiṣṭhineyas samagriya syāt sa etena yajeta gacchati jyaiṣṭhyaṃ na 
jyaiṣṭhyād avarohati /97/


JB 2.98
|va	 athaiṣa durāśaḥ 
|vb	 paurṇamāsena haviṣeṣṭvā ādityāya caruṃ nirvapati 
|vc	 tasmiñ chatamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti suvarṇaṃ candramase 'parāhṇe 
|vd	 tasmiñ chatamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti rajatam 
|ve	 sa evam etau pūrvāhṇāparāhṇāv etam aparapakṣaṃ yajate 
|vf	 tasyāmāvāsyāyāṃ dīkṣopariṣṭāt sutyā 
|vg	 tad vā etat sūryācandramasor evāyanam 
|vh	 sūryācandramasau vā akāmayetāṃ samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ṛddhnuyāva 
|vi	 ahar eva nāv anyataro 'bhijayed rātrim anyatara iti 
|vj	 tāv etaṃ yajñam apaśyatām 
|vk	 tam āharatām 
|vl	 tenāyajetām 
|vm	 tato vai tau samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ārdhnutām 
|vn	 ahar evainayor anyataro 'bhyajayad rātrim anyataraḥ 
|vo	 eṣā ha vā enayoḥ samāny ṛddhir yat samāne loke pūrvāhṇāparāhṇau yajate 
|vp	 ahar vai pūrvāhṇo rātrir aparāhṇo 'horātrayor evābhijityai 
|vq	 pūrvapakṣāparapakṣau yajate 
|vr	 ahar vai pūrvapakṣo rātrir aparapakṣo 'horātrayor evābhijityai 
|vs	 śatamāne bhavataḥ 
|vt	 śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ śatavīryas tasyaivendriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai 
/98/


JB 2.99
|va	 saptadaśa stomo bhavati 
|vb	 prajāpatir vai saptadaśa 
|vc	 prajāpati svargasya lokasyābhinayitā 
|vd	 sa mā svargaṃ lokam abhinayād iti 
|ve	 tasya śatam anaḍvāho dakṣiṇā bhavanti 
|vf	 śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ śatavīryas tasyaivendriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai 
|vg	 sarve vahnayo bhavanti 
|vh	 vahninā hi tatra gacchati yatra jigamiṣati 
|vi	 sarve varā bhavanti 
|vj	 vara iva vai svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasyarddhyai 
|vk	 etad anyo dadyād athānya stotre stotre saptadaśa saptadaśa niṣkān dadyāt 
|vl	 devāsurā yajñe 'spardhanta 
|vm	 te yad yad eva devā yajñe 'kurvata tat tad v evāsurā anvakurvata 
|vn	 te devā abruvan yad yad vāva vayaṃ yajñe kurmahe tat tan no 'surā anukurvate 
|vo	 eta hiraṇyasomena yajāmahā iti 
|vp	 atha ha tarhi deveṣv eva hiraṇyam āsa nāsureṣu 
|vq	 saṃvṛktaṃ ha devair asurāṇāṃ hiraṇyam āsa 
|vr	 te hiraṇyasomenāyajanta 
|vs	 te stotre stotre saptadaśa saptadaśa niṣkān adaduḥ 
|vt	 tad eṣām asurā nodāśnuvata 
|vu	 te 'bruvan durāśaṃ batedaṃ devā akrateti 
|vv	 tad eva durāśasya durāśatvam 
|vw	 tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ 
|vx	 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vy	 tasya śukracandre ādiṣṭasāmanī pavamānayor bhavataḥ 
|vz	 sūryācandramasor hy eṣa yajñaḥ 
|vā	 stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti /99/


JB 2.100
|va	 athaiṣo 'pacitiḥ 
|vb	 prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata 
|vc	 tā enaṃ sṛṣṭā nāpācāyan 
|vd	 so 'kāmayata apacitim āsu prajāsu gaccheyam iti 
|ve	 sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|vf	 tam āharat 
|vg	 tenāyajata 
|vh	 tato vai taṃ tā apācāyan 
|vi	 indram u vai devā nāpācāyan 
|vj	 sa prajāpatim upādhāvan na vai meme devā apacāyantīti 
|vk	 tasmā etam apacitiṃ yajñaṃ vyadadhāt 
|vl	 tam āharat 
|vm	 tenāyajata 
|vn	 tato vai taṃ devā apācāyan 
|vo	 darbham u ha vai śātānīkiṃ pañcālā rājānaṃ santaṃ nāpacāyāṃ cakruḥ 
|vp	 api ha smainaṃ kumārā darbha darbheti hvayanti 
|vq	 tasya haitau brāhmaṇāv āsatur ahīnā āśvatthiḥ keśī sātyakāmir iti 
|vr	 tau hainam upasameyatuḥ 
|vs	 sa ha dhyāyan niṣasāda 
|vt	 taṃ hocatuḥ 
|vu	 kiṃ nu rājanyo dhyāyatīti 
|vv	 sa hovāca na hi me dhyeyam {Dieselbe Ausdrucksweise in 2,122 (212,13ff)}
|vw	 pañcālā vai meme rājānaṃ santaṃ nāpacāyanty api mā kumārā darbha darbheti 
hvayanti 
|vx	 tad evaitad dhyāyāmīti 
|vy	 taṃ hocatur apacitir iti vā ayaṃ yajñakratur asti tena tvā yājayāveti 
|vz	 tatheti 
|vā	 tena hainaṃ yājayāṃ cakratuḥ 
|vab	 sa haiṣu tathāmātram apacitiṃ jagāma yad apy etarhi pañcālā darbhān kuśā ity 
evācakṣate /100/


JB 2.101
|va	 asya vā etasya gāyatrīm eva prātassavanaṃ saṃpadyate triṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ 
savanaṃ jagatīṃ tṛtīyasavanam 
|vb	 tad yad gāyatrīṃ prātassavanaṃ saṃpadyate 'ṣṭākṣarā gāyatry aṣṭau vasavo 
gāyatryaiva tac chandasā prajāpatiś cendraś ca vasuṣu deveṣu prātassavane 'dhy 
apicitim agacchatām 
|vc	 atha yat triṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpadyata ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭub 
ekādaśa rudrās triṣṭubhaiva tac chandasā prajāpatiś cendraś ca rudreṣu deveṣu 
mādhyandine savane 'dhy apacitim agacchatām 
|vd	 atha yaj jagatīṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ saṃpadyate dvādaśākṣarā jagatī dvādaśādityā 
jagatyaiva tac chandasā prajāpatiś cendraś cādityeṣu deveṣu tṛtīyasavane 'dhy 
apacitim agacchatām 
|ve	 aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī 
|vf	 ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup 
|vg	 dvādaśākṣarā jagatī 
|vh	 vāg iti yajñāyajñīyasya nidhanam 
|vi	 tad dvātriṃśat 
|vj	 dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup 
|vk	 viśveṣāṃ devānām anuṣṭup 
|vl	 anuṣṭubhaiva tac chandasā prajāpatiś cendraś ca viśveṣu deveṣu tṛtīyasavane 'dhy 
apacitim agacchatām 
|vm	 etāvanto vai devāḥ 
|vn	 etāvanti devajātāni 
|vo	 teṣv eva tad adhy apacitim agacchatām /101/


JB 2.102
|va	 gāyatro vai brāhmaṇaḥ 
|vb	 traiṣṭubho rājanyaḥ 
|vc	 jāgato vaiśyaḥ 
|vd	 ānuṣṭubhaḥ śūdraḥ 
|ve	 tad yad gāyatrīṃ prātassavanaṃ saṃpadyate gāyatryaiva tac chandasā darbhaḥ 
śātānīkir brāhmaṇe manuṣye 'dhy apacitim agacchat 
|vf	 atha yat triṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpadyate triṣṭubhaiva tac chandasā 
darbhaḥ śātānīkī rājanye manuṣye 'dhy apacitim agacchat 
|vg	 atha yaj jagatīṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ saṃpadyate jagatyaiva tac chandasā darbhaḥ 
śātānīkir vaiśye manuṣye 'dhy apacitim agacchat 
|vh	 aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī 
|vi	 ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup 
|vj	 dvādaśākṣarā jagatī 
|vk	 vāg iti yajñāyajñīyasya nidhanam 
|vl	 tad dvātriṃśat 
|vm	 dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup 
|vn	 ānuṣṭubhaḥ śūdraḥ 
|vo	 anuṣṭubhaiva tac chandasā darbhaḥ śātānīkiḥ śūdre manuṣye 'dhy apacitim agacchat 
|vp	 etāvanto vai manuṣyāḥ 
|vq	 etāvanti manuṣyajātāni 
|vr	 teṣv eva tad adhy apacitim agacchat /102/


JB 2.103
|va	 tad āhuḥ kaitasya yajñasya vidhṛtiḥ kāpacitir iti 
|vb	 sa brūyād yad eva savanāt savanaṃ na samaiti 
|vc	 yad a[sa]maiva savanaṃ saṃpadyate saivaitasya yajñasya vidhṛtis sāpacitir iti 
|vd	 tasya āhur <davidyutatyā ruce>ty eva pratipadaṃ kāryām 
|ve	 eṣā vai gaṇinī pratipad bahurūpā 
|vf	 gaṇā iva vai taṃ sacante ya śriyam aśnuta iti 
|vg	 tad u vā āhuḥ <pavasva vāco agriya upāsmai gāyatā nara> ity ete eva pratipadau 
kārye 
|vh	 ete vāva gaṇinyau pratipadau bahurūpe 
|vi	 atho ubhe hy atra sāmanī kriyete 
|vj	 tasmād ete eva pratipadau kārye iti 
|vk	 bṛhadrathantare bhavataḥ 
|vl	 brahma vai rathantaraṃ kṣatraṃ bṛhat 
|vm	 brahma ca vai kṣatraṃ cāpacite rūpam 
|vn	 bhadraśreyasī bhavataḥ 
|vo	 bhadreṇa vai devā bhadrā abhavañ chreyasā śriyam agacchan 
|vp	 sahomahasī bhavataḥ 
|vq	 sahasā vai devā asurān asahanta 
|vr	 mahasā maho 'bhavan 
|vs	 bhargayaśasī bhavataḥ 
|vt	 bhargeṇa vai devā bhargo 'bhavan 
|vu	 yaśasā yaśo 'gacchan 
|vv	 utsedhaniṣedhau bhavataḥ 
|vw	 utsedhena vai devā autsedhyam udasedhan 
|vx	 niṣedhena niṣedhyaṃ nyaṣedhan 
|vy	 sadoviśīyaṃ ca viśoviśīyaṃ ca bhavataḥ 
|vz	 sadoviśīyena vai devā viśam asīdan 
|vā	 viśoviśīyena viśo viśo rājāno 'bhavan 
|vab	 dharmavidharmaṇī bhavataḥ 
|vac	 dharmeṇa vai devā dharmo 'bhavan 
|vad	 vidharmaṇā vidharmāpāghnata 
|vae	 tasmin etā ubhayīr dvipadāticchandasaḥ kriyante jyeṣṭhāni ca hrasiṣṭhāni ca 
chandāṃsi 
|vaf	 paśavo vai chandāṃsi 
|vag	 tasmād bhūtam ubhaye paśava upatiṣṭhante jyeṣṭhāś ca hrasiṣṭhāś ca 
|vah	 ubhaye ha vā enaṃ paśava upatiṣṭhante jyeṣṭhāś ca hrasiṣṭhāś ca ya evaṃ veda 
|vai	 tasyāśvarathaś caturyug dakṣiṇā bhavati 
|vaj	 sarve śatakriyo 'śvāḥ 
|vak	 sa rukmī prāvepī sarvābharaṇy aṃśumān bhavati 
|val	 tasya vaiyāghraḥ parivāro bhavati dvaipo dhanvadhir ārkṣa upāsaṅgaḥ 
|vam	 khāḍgakavaco 'dhyāsthātā bhavati saṃnaddhas saṃnaddhasārathir āvṛtaḥ 
pratihitābhyām 
|van	 niṣkī sragvī saṃgrahītā bhavati 
|vao	 etad vai tviṣe rūpam etad apaciteḥ 
|vap	 tasminn etad apacitaṃ dhanaṃ dadāti 
|vaq	 apacitā evāpacitaṃ dhanaṃ dadānīti 
|var	 stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti /103/


JB 2.104
|va	 athaitāv abhibhūś ca vinuttiś ca 
|vb	 devāsurā aspardhanta 
|vc	 te devā akāmayantābhīmān asurān bhavemeti 
|vd	 ta etat abhibhuvaṃ yajñam apaśyan 
|ve	 tam āharan 
|vf	 tenāyajanta 
|vg	 tenāsurān abhyabhavan 
|vh	 yad abhyabhavaṃs tad abhibhuvo 'bhibhūtvam 
|vi	 abhi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vj	 tasya trivṛtāv abhito bhavataḥ 
|vk	 brahma vai trivṛt 
|vl	 brahmaṇā vā enāṃs tad abhyabhavan 
|vm	 brahmaṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam abhibhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vn	 te jitās trastriṃśam eva pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpadyanta 
|vo	 yathā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ variṣṭhāyāṃ puri pariyateraṃs tathā tān akāmayantāta enān 
vinudemahīti 
|vp	 ta etaṃ vinuttiṃ yajñam apaśyan 
|vq	 tam āharan 
|vr	 tenāyajanta 
|vs	 tata enān vyanudanta 
|vt	 yad vyanudanta tad vinutter vinuttitvam 
|vu	 vi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate ya evaṃ veda 
|vv	 tasya trivṛtau madhye bhavataḥ 
|vw	 brahma vai trivṛt 
|vx	 brahmaṇā vā enāṃs tad vyanudanta 
|vy	 brahmaṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ vinudate ya evaṃ veda /104/


JB 2.105
|va	 atho āhur agnir evaiṣa yat trivṛt stomaḥ 
|vb	 tad yathā bhramalān saṃpannān agninābhyauṣed evam evaināṃs tat trivṛtā agninā 
stomena trayastriṃśābhyām ubhayata upamāryābhyauṣan 
|vc	 te vipalayyemām upāsarpann iti 
|vd	 tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ 
|ve	 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vf	 atho āhuḥ purodhākāma evainena yajeta yad abhibhūr iti 
|vg	 tasya trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas trayastriṃśau madhye 
|vh	 brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ trayastriṃśaḥ 
|vi	 brahmaṇaiva tad ubhayataḥ kṣatraṃ parigṛhṇāti 
|vj	 yado vai brahmaṇā kṣatraṃ parigṛhṇāty atha sa tasya purodhāṃ gacchati 
|vk	 gacchati purodhāṃ pura enaṃ dadhate 
|vl	 atho āhur antasthākāma evainena yajeta yad vinuttir iti 
|vm	 tasya trivṛttau madhye bhavatas trayastriṃśāv abhitaḥ 
|vn	 brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ trayastriṃśaḥ 
|vo	 kṣatreṇaiva tad ubhayato brahma parigṛhṇāti 
|vp	 yado vai kṣatreṇa brahma parigṛhṇāty atha sa tasyāntasthāṃ tiṣṭhati 
|vq	 tiṣṭhaty antasthāṃ nāntasthāyāṃ jīyate 
|vr	 atho āhū rājānau hed vā etau stomau stomarājāv iti /105/


JB 2.106
|va	 tasya vā etasyābhibhuvas trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas trayastriṃśau madhye 
|vb	 tayoṣ ṣaṭṣaṣṭi stotryāḥ 
|vc	 tato yāṣ ṣaṣṭir āsandī sā 
|vd	 atha yāś catasra āsandīpādās te 
|ve	 atha ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipād etasyāṃ rājāsandyām adhyūḍhaḥ 
|vf	 gacchati rājyaṃ ya evaṃ veda 
|vg	 yady asmin loke nātha vā amuṣmin 
|vh	 atho āhur yasya dvāv etau trivṛtau madhye madhye sā hed vā apy āsandīti 
|vi	 madhye vinateva vā āsandī 
|vj	 madhye vinata ivaiṣa 
|vk	 sā ha vai suṣimattarā yā madhye vinatā 
|vl	 gacchati rājyaṃ ya evaṃ veda yady asmin loke nātha vā amuṣmin 
|vm	 atho āhuḥ punar asau hed vā etau yajñakratū iti 
|vn	 ṣaḍ vā etayor iti ūrdhvā stomā udyanti 
|vo	 ṣaḍ amuto 'rvāñcaś ṣaḍbhir evete ūrdhvaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati praty evāmutaṣ 
ṣaḍbhir avarohati gacchati svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭhati 
|vp	 atho ha veda yo 'sāv āsaṃ so 'yam asmīti punar haivāsmin loka ājāyate 
|vq	 atho āhu svargakāma id ya ābhyām apiyajeteti /106/


JB 2.107
|va	 tayor vā etayos saha trivṛtau saha pañcadaśau saha saptadaśau sahaikaviṃśau saha 
triñavau saha trayastriṃśau 
|vb	 sa yathā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pratitiṣṭhann iyād evam evaitābhyāṃ svarge loke 
pratitiṣṭhati 
|vc	 atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā etau yajñakratū iti 
|vd	 sa yas saṃvatsarabhṛtā vāsaṃvatsarabhṛtā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etābhyāṃ 
yajeta 
|ve	 sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara ṛtuśo māsaśo 'rdhamāsaśo 'nviṣṭo bhavati 
|vf	 tad yat pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni 
|vg	 saṃvatsara ṛtavas tenartuśaḥ 
|vh	 atha yad dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras tena māsaśaḥ 
|vi	 atha yac caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaras 
tenārdhamāsaśaḥ 
|vj	 sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsaro 'nviṣṭo bhavati ya evaṃ veda /107/


JB 2.108
|va	 athaiṣa manustomaḥ 
|vb	 manur vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti 
|vc	 sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|vd	 tam āharat 
|ve	 tenāyajata 
|vf	 tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata 
|vg	 tā imā mānavīḥ prajā asṛjata 
|vh	 sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajāḥ sṛjeyeti sa etena 
yajeta 
|vi	 bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate mānavīḥ prajās sṛjate 
|vj	 tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanti 
|vk	 ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni 
|vl	 saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ 
|vm	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam 
|vn	 sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti 
|vo	 tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś caiva 
|vp	 tad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhaye stomāḥ 
|vq	 tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti 
|vr	 tasya vyatiṣaktā stomā bhavanti vyatiṣaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante 
prajātyā eva 
|vs	 tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ 
|vt	 etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare 
|vu	 tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti 
|vv	 tasya chandomāḥ pavamānā bhavanti 
|vw	 paśavo vai chandomāḥ 
|vx	 paśavaḥ prajananam 
|vy	 tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti 
|vz	 tasya mānavaṃ brahmasāma bhavati 
|vā	 brahma vai brahmasāma 
|vab	 yajamānakāmo eṣa yad brahmasāma sva eva tad āyatane yajamānaṃ kāmais 
samardhayanti 
|vac	 sa ukthyo bhavati 
|vad	 prajā vai paśava ukthāni 
|vae	 prajā vai paśavaḥ prajananam 
|vaf	 tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti /108/


JB 2.109
|va	 atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti 
|vb	 sa yas saṃvatsarabhṛtā vāsaṃvatsarabhṛtā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etena yajeta 
|vc	 sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara ṛtuśo 'rdhamāsaśo māsaśo rātriśo 'nviṣṭo bhavati 
|vd	 tad yat pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni saṃvatsara ṛtavas 
tenartuśaḥ 
|ve	 atha yat pañcadaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti pañcadaśa vārdhamāsasya rātrayas 
tenārdhamāsaśaḥ 
|vf	 atha yat triṃśat stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti triṃśan māsasya rātrayas tena māsaśaḥ 
|vg	 atha yat trīṇi [ṣaṣṭi]śatāni stotriyā bhavanti tāvatīḥ saṃvatsarasya rātrayas tena 
rātriśaḥ 
|vh	 sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsaro 'nviṣṭo bhavati ya evaṃ veda 
|vi	 tāḥ prajanyākāmayata svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccheyam iti 
|vj	 sa etam uttaram manustomam apaśyat 
|vk	 tam āharat 
|vl	 tenāyajata 
|vm	 tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni 
|vn	 saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ 
|vo	 saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vp	 tasyordhvā stomā bhavanty ūrdhvo vai svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya 
samaṣṭyai 
|vq	 tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata svargye svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vr	 tasya chandomāḥ pavamānā bhavanti paśavo vai chandomāḥ 
|vs	 paśava svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vt	 tasya pañcaviṃśaṃ brahmasāma bhavati 
|vu	 annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam 
|vv	 yajamānakāmo vā eṣa yad brahmasāma 
|vw	 sva eva tad āyatane yajamānam annādyena samardhayanti 
|vx	 sa ukthyo bhavati prajā vai paśava ukthāni 
|vy	 prajā vai paśava svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai /109/


JB 2.110
|va	 atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti 
|vb	 tata eva rātrim upayanti 
|vc	 atirātreṇa vai devā ūrdhvā svargaṃ lokam āyan 
|vd	 te svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvā sārdham evāvyavasitā āsata 
|ve	 diśo 'prajānānās te akāmayanta diśaḥ prajānīyāmeti 
|vf	 ahorātrayor ha vai parastāt svargo lokaḥ 
|vg	 ta etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyan 
|vh	 tair astuvata 
|vi	 tair eva stutvā diśaḥ prājānan 
|vj	 tato vai te yatra yatra svargasya lokasyākāmayanta tat tad vyavāsyan 
|vk	 yatra yatra ha vai svargasya lokasya kāmayate tat tad vyavasyati ya evaṃ vedeti ha 
smāha jānaśruteyaḥ 
|vl	 atha ha smāha vaitahavyaḥ 
|vm	 prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata 
|vn	 te 'smāt sṛṣṭāḥ prādravan 
|vo	 tān agniṣṭomenāvivārayiṣata 
|vp	 te tad atyādravan 
|vq	 tān ukthyenāvivārayiṣata 
|vr	 te tad atyādravan 
|vs	 tān ṣoḍaśināvivārayiṣata 
|vt	 te tad aty evādravan 
|vu	 tān paryāyaiḥ paryāyam ait 
|vv	 yat paryāyaiḥ paryāyam ait tat paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyatvam 
|vw	 tān āśvinena kratunā paryagṛhṇāt 
|vx	 teṣāṃ parigṛhītānāṃ yathā kṣudrā matsyā akṣor akṣy atiśīyerann evam eva ye 
kṣudrāḥ paśava āsus te 'tiśeduḥ 
|vy	 tān akāmayatāptvainān ātman yaccheyam iti 
|vz	 sa etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyat 
|vā	 tair astuta 
|vab	 tair evainān āptvātmany ayacchat 
|vac	 yad āptvātmany ayacchat tasmād aptoryāmaḥ 
|vad	 yad v evāptuśa iva somasya prabhāvayann anv etasmād aptoryāmaḥ /110/


JB 2.111
|va	 tā dvāṣaṣṭi stotriyās saṃpadyante 
|vb	 tato yāṣ ṣaṣṭis sā virāṭ 
|vc	 paśavo virāṭ 
|vd	 atha ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipāt parastāt paryūḍhaḥ 
|ve	 paśūnāṃ guptyai paśūnām aparāvāpāya 
|vf	 nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda 
|vg	 atho āhur ekam evaitat stotraṃ sat tac caturdhā vihṛtya stuyuṣ ṣaḍbhir eva hotre 
stuyuṣ ṣaḍbhir maitrāvaruṇāya ṣaḍbhir brāhmaṇācchaṃsine ṣaḍbhir acchāvākāya 
|vh	 tad u hotaivānuśaṃsed iti 
|vi	 tāś caturviṃśati stotryās saṃpadyante 
|vj	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vk	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ 
|vl	 prajāpatir evaiṣa parastāt paryūḍhaḥ 
|vm	 paśūnāṃ guptyai paśūnām aparāvāpāya 
|vn	 nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda 
|vo	 tad u vā āhus trivṛt pañcadaśaṃ saptadaśam ekaviṃśam ity evaitāni stotrāṇi syuḥ 
|vp	 ekaviṃśaṃ vā anu sarve yajñakratavas saṃtiṣṭhante 
|vq	 atho eṣa vāva dṛḍhaḥ pratiṣṭhita stomo yad ekaviṃśaḥ 
|vr	 tasmād ekaviṃśa eva stomo 'ntataḥ kārya iti 
|vs	 tad āhuḥ pṛṣṭharūpair evānviyur iti /111/


JB 2.112
|va	 <abhi tvā vṛṣabhā suta> ity ārṣabham 
|vb	 abhīti rathantarasya rūpam 
|vc	 tena rathantarasya rūpān na yanti 
|vd	 <yad adya kac ca vṛtrahann> iti śākalaṃ hiṃkāravad vāmadevyasya rūpam 
|ve	 tena vāmadevyasya rūpān na yanti 
|vf	 <tam indraṃ vājayāmasī>ty edāvasunidhanaṃ (?) bahirnidhanaṃ bṛhato rūpam 
|vg	 tena bṛhato rūpān na yanty atho paśavo vai vasu paśūnām evāvaruddhyai 
|vh	 atho haināṃs tad idaṃ vasv ity evāptvopeyāy<edaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama> itīḍānāṃ 
saṃkṣāraḥ paśavo vā iḍānāṃ saṃkṣāraḥ paśūnām evāvaruddhyai 
|vi	 etad dha vā enāṃs tan nijuhva <ehīḍā ehīḍā> iti paśavo vā iḍā tasmād etāny 
atiriktokthāni kāryāṇīti 
|vj	 tad u hovāca tāṇḍyaḥ prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata 
|vk	 te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāman 
|vl	 so 'gnim abravīd etān me vārayasveti 
|vm	 tān sa jarābodhīyena nāvārayata 
|vn	 sa indram abravīd etān me vārayasyeti 
|vo	 tān sa satrāsāhīyena nāvārayata 
|vp	 sa īśānaṃ devam abravīd etān me vārayasveti 
|vq	 tān sa mārgīyaveṇa naivāvārayata 
|vr	 sa viṣṇum abravīd etān me vārayasveti 
|vs	 tān sa vaiṣṇavīṣu vāravantīyenaivāvārayata 
|vt	 yad avārayata tad vāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam 
|vu	 tasmād etāny atiriktokthāni kāryāṇy eveti /112/


JB 2.113
|va	 athaiṣa gosavaḥ 
|vb	 svargakāmo haitena yajeta 
|vc	 sa vā eṣa ṣaṭtriṃśo bhavati 
|vd	 ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā vai bṛhatī 
|ve	 bṛhatī svargo lokaḥ sāmrājyaṃ 
|vf	 bṛhatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭhanto yanti 
|vg	 bṛhaty u ha vā imān sarvān lokān akṣarair vyāpnoti daśabhir evākṣarair imaṃ 
lokaṃ vyāpnoti daśabhir antarikṣaṃ daśabhir amuṃ caturbhir diśo dvābhyām 
ahorātre 
|vh	 sā yemāṃl lokān vyāpnoti tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnavānīti 
|vi	 tasya stotraṃ stotraṃ caturaś caturas trivṛto 'bhisaṃpadyate 
|vj	 trivṛtaṃ vā anye stomā abhisaṃpadyante trivṛt svargaṃ lokam 
|vk	 sa yathā kṣiprāśvena caturyujā yatra jigamiṣet tad gacched evam evaitena svargaṃ 
lokaṃ gacchati 
|vl	 tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata svargye svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vm	 sa ukthyo bhavati prajā vai paśava ukthāni 
|vn	 prajā vai paśava svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vo	 tasya dvādaśa sahasrāṇi dakṣiṇā bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara 
svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vp	 tasya vratam 
|vq	 upa mātaram iyād upa svasāram upa sagotrām 
|vr	 upāhvaryodakam ācāmed upāhvarya tṛṇāny āchindyāt 
|vs	 yatra yatrainaṃ viṣṭhā vindet tat tad vitiṣṭheta 
|vt	 anaḍuho ha lokaṃ jayati 
|vu	 tena haitena janako vaideho iyakṣāṃ cakre 
|vv	 tam u ha brāhmaṇā abhito niṣeduḥ 
|vw	 sa ha papraccha ka stoma iti 
|vx	 sa hovāca sudakṣiṇaḥ kṣaimir nāyaṃ trivṛd evāhur iti 
|vy	 tasya kiṃ vrataṃ kā dakṣiṇā iti 
|vz	 tasmā u haitat provāca 
|vā	 sa hovāca ud evāsya dakṣiṇā āśaṃse vrataṃ tv evāsya nodāśaṃsa iti 
|vab	 teno ha sa nopadadharṣa yaṣṭum 
|vac	 teno ha puṇyakeśo yaudhenir īje śaibyo rājā 
|vad	 taṃ ha sabhāyām eva viṣṭhā viveda 
|vae	 sa ha tad evodāvṛṇāna uvāca sthavirayajño vāva kilāyam āsa 
|vaf	 sthavira evānena yajñena yajeta 
|vag	 sthavirasya hy evedaṃ sarvam anujñātam iti 
|vah	 sa haiṣa sthavirayajña eva 
|vai	 tena haitenottaravayasy e[va] yajeta /113/


JB 2.114
|va	 athaiṣa vivadhaḥ 
|vb	 paśukāmo haitena yajeta 
|vc	 sa vā eṣa ṣaṭ ca paṅktīr abhisaṃpadyate daśa ca stotryāḥ 
|vd	 tato yāṣ ṣaṭ paṅktayaḥ paśavas te 
|ve	 atha yā daśa stotryāḥ paśūnām eva sa dohaḥ 
|vf	 paya evaiṣāṃ tat 
|vg	 te u eva dve pañca pañca pañcinyau paṅktyau saṃpadyete 
|vh	 ta u te paśava eva 
|vi	 tasya saviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ bhavati sadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ 
saviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam 
|vj	 tad yathā ha vai vivadhasyobhayatas saguru savivadhatāyai tādṛk tad yat sadaśaṃ 
mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ bhavati 
|vk	 saviṃśe abhitaḥ pūrvārdhaṃ ca jaghanārdhaṃ ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhājayanti 
|vl	 tasmāt paśavaḥ pūrvārdhena ca jaghanārdhena ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhājayanti 
|vm	 vahanti pūrvārdhena duhre ca jaghanārdhena pra ca janayanti 
|vn	 ubhayaṃ dhenupayasaṃ cānaḍutpayasaṃ cāvarundhe ya evaṃ veda 
|vo	 tasminn u ha tarhy ubhe bṛhadrathantare kuryur dvayā u ha vai paśavo rāthantarā 
anye bārhatā anye 
|vp	 ye ha vā anyatodantāḥ paśavas te rāthantarā ya ubhayatodantās te bārhatā 
ubhayeṣām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai 
|vq	 sa ukthyo bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai 
|vr	 tasyodvaṃśīyam acchāvākasāma bhavati sarvapṛṣṭharūpaṃ pṛṣṭhāni vai paśavo 
'bhipūrvāṇām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai /114/


JB 2.115
|va	 athaiṣa sadyaḥkrīḥ 
|vb	 te vṛtā nāpākrāman 
|vc	 ta etyāyājayan 
|vd	 tebhya etāṃ vācaṃ vaḍavāṃ śvetāṃ bhūtāṃ aśvābhidhānyabhihitām ānayann imāṃ 
pratigṛhṇīteti 
|ve	 te 'bruvan śreyasīyam asman no imām udyaṃsyāma iti 
|vf	 sā kruddhā na mā pratyagṛhṇann iti siṃhy ubhayatomukhī bhūtvordhvodakrāmat 
|vg	 sobhayān devāsurān antarātiṣṭhad yaṃ devānām upāpnod yaṃ asurāṇāṃ tam 
ādadānā 
|vh	 tām upaiva devā amantrayantopāsurāḥ 
|vi	 sā devān abhyupāvartamānābravīt kiṃ me tata syād yad vo 'bhyupāvarteyeti 
|vj	 pūrvāṃ tvāgner āhutir aśnuvīteti 
|vk	 tām adhvare 'vākalpayan 
|vl	 saiṣottaravediḥ 
|vm	 tām etāṃ pūrvām agner āhutir aśnute /115/


JB 2.116
|va	 dhārayanty agniṃ vyādhārayanty uttaravedim 
|vb	 etad enāṃ tat pūrvām agner āhutir aśnute 
|vc	 athaitebhya etam ādityā ādityam evāśvaṃ śvetaṃ bhūtam aśvābhidhānyabhihitam 
ānayann imam u vai pratigṛhṇīteti 
|vd	 te 'bruvan śreyān u vāvāyam asman no vāvemam udyaṃsyāma iti 
|ve	 tān devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan vicchetsyante vā adakṣiṇā yajñāḥ 
pratigṛhṇīteti 
|vf	 tad eṣābhyanūcyate

|vh	 <taṃ ha jaritar na pratyāyaṃs taṃ ha jaritar na pratyagṛhṇaṃs>

JB 2.117
|va	 <ādityā rudrā vasavas>< tveḍata idaṃ rādhaḥ pratigṛhṇīhy aṅgira> 
|vb	 <idaṃ rādho bṛhat pṛthu devā dadatu vo varam> 
|vc	 <tad vo astu sucetanaṃ> 
|vd	 <yuṣme astu dive dive praty eva gṛbhāyata> 
|ve	 ity evainān pratyagrāhayan 
|vf	 tato vā ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam āgacchan ahīyantāṅgirasaḥ 
|vg	 sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etena yajeta 
|vh	 hīyate 'sya pāpmā bhrātṛvyo gacchati svargaṃ lokam 
|vi	 yavorvarā vedir bhavati 
|vj	 sā hi purākṛtā bhavati 
|vk	 yavānām uttaravediḥ 
|vl	 yavair vā ādityā aṅgirasāṃ yajñam ayuvata 
|vm	 yad yajñaṃ yavair ayuvata tad yavānāṃ yavatvam 
|vn	 yavair eva dviṣato bhrātṛvyasya yajñaṃ yute 
|vo	 khalevalā yūpa sphyāgro bhavaty aindraḥ 
|vp	 vijityai saha paśū ālabhante samaṣṭyai 
|vq	 pumān gaus somakrayaṇo bhavati vīryaṃ vai pumān vīryavanto 'sāmeti 
|vr	 sāṇḍo bhavati sendratvāya 
|vs	 kuṃbhyā vasatīvaryyo bhavanti yaḥ purejānas tasya gṛhebhyaḥ 
|vt	 tā hi purāgṛhītā bhavanti 
|vu	 sarpiṣmantam aśitvā nipadyate 
|vv	 yam evāmuṃ dīkṣaṇīyam aśnāti sa evāsya so 'śito bhavati 
|vw	 priyāyai jāyāyā antarorū śete 'nipadyamānaḥ 
|vx	 tapasyam evāsya tad dhiraṇyam mukha ādhāya śete 
|vy	 satyaṃ vai hiraṇyam 
|vz	 satyam evāsya tad uditaṃ bhavati /117/


JB 2.118
|va	 aśva śveto dakṣiṇā bhavati svargyo vā aśva svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vb	 aśvarathas somapravāko bhavati yojanaṃ paramam 
|vc	 etad dha vai paramāṇām adhvānām avamaṃ yad yojanam avamānāṃ vā paramam 
|vd	 tasmin dadhidṛtir upāvahito bhavati 
|ve	 tasya yat sarpis saṃpatati tad ājyakuṃbhe 'vāsyanti 
|vf	 tad dhi sadyojam iva dvikrośam itthaṃ dvikrośam ittham ṛtvijo vinihitā bhavanti 
|vg	 ta enaṃ prātar upasametya yājayanti 
|vh	 sa juhvat trir nimīlayati trir vīkṣate 
|vi	 tā eva dīkṣopasadaḥ /118/


JB 2.119
|va	 sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati brahma vai trivṛt 
|vb	 brahma rathantaraṃ brahmaṇā svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vc	 atho āhus trivṛd eva bṛhatsāma syād iti 
|vd	 brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ bṛhat 
|ve	 brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca saṃyugbhyāṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vf	 tad u vā āhus trivṛd eva rathantasāmā syāt 
|vg	 brahma vai trivṛt 
|vh	 brahma vai rathantaram 
|vi	 brahma vai svargasya lokasyeśe 
|vj	 tasmiṃs trivṛd eva rathantarasāmā syād iti 
|vk	 tasminn āhur iyavanti sāmāni kāryāṇy iyavadbhir vai devā svargaṃ lokam 
agacchann iyavadbhi svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vl	 atho āhur yāny evāgniyonīni sāmāni tāni kāryāṇi 
|vm	 aśṛta iva vā eṣa yat sadyaḥkrīḥ 
|vn	 agnir vā aśṛtasya śrapayiteti 
|vo	 tad u vā āhur agniṣṭomasāmāny eva kāryāṇīti 
|vp	 etāni vā agniyonīni yad agniṣṭomasāmāni 
|vq	 tasmād agniṣṭomasāmāny eva kāryāṇīti 
|vr	 athaiṣa {Die Ed: kāryāṇy ityathaiṣa} kṣiprāt kṣepīyān kṣiprāt kṣepīya svargaṃ 
lokaṃ gacchāmeti 
|vs	 tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara svargo loka 
svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai 
|vt	 tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ

JB 2.120
|va	 athaitāv anukriyau 
|vb	 ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta

JB 2.122
|va	 athaiṣa parikrīḥ 
|vb	 khaṇḍikaś ca haudbhāriḥ keśī ca dārbhyaḥ pāñcāleṣu paspṛdhāte 
|vc	 sa ha khaṇḍikaḥ keśinam abhiprajighāya 
|vd	 sadyaḥkriyā vai syo yakṣyata iti 
|ve	 atha haitena procya bhrātṛvyāya yajante 
|vf	 tasya haite brāhmaṇā āsur ahīnā āśvatthiḥ keśī sātyakāmir gaṅginā rāhakṣito 
luśākapiḥ khārgalir iti 
|vg	 te hainam upasameyuḥ 
|vh	 sa ha dhyāyan niṣasāda 
|vi	 taṃ hocuḥ kiṃ nu rājanyo dhyāyatīti 
|vj	 sa hovāca na hi me dhyeyam {Dieselbe Ausdrucksweise in 2,100 (201,16f)}
|vk	 yūyaṃ brāhmaṇā anubrūthādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta

JB 2.123
|va	 tam u vai māyaṃ khaṇḍiko 'bhiprāhaiṣīt sayaḥkriyā vai syo yakṣyata iti 
|vb	 sa eva nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati parā syo bhaviṣyatīty evaitad dhyāyāmīti 
|vc	 taṃ hocuḥ parikrīr iti vā ayaṃ yajñakratur asti 
|vd	 tena tvā yājayāmeti 
|ve	 tatheti 
|vf	 tena hainaṃ yājayāṃ cakruḥ 
|vg	 tasya vā etasya tṛcasya tṛcasyaikaikayā stuvanti 
|vh	 brahma vai prathamā stotriyā kṣatraṃ dvitīyā viṭ tṛtīyā 
|vi	 avalamba u ha vai brahmaṇaḥ kṣatraṃ ca viṭ ca 
|vj	 kṣatraṃ co ha vai viśaṃ cānu bhrātṛvyalokaḥ 
|vk	 sa ye dve avaciccheda bhrātṛvyalokam eva tad avaciccheda 
|vl	 ātmā vai prathamā stotriyā jāyā dvitīyā prajā tṛtīyā 
|vm	 avalamba u ha vā ātmano jāyā ca prajā ca 
|vn	 jāyāṃ co ha vai prajāṃ cānu bhrātṛvyalokaḥ 
|vo	 sa ye dve avaciccheda bhrātṛvyalokam eva tad avaciccheda /123/


JB 2.124
|va	 tato vai sa khaṇḍikaṃ niḥsārayāṃ cakāra 
|vb	 tato vai keśī dārbhyo 'bhavat parā khaṇḍikaḥ

|vd	 tasya tisṛṣu bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati catasṛṣv ājyāni pañcasu mādhyaṃdinaḥ 
pavamānaś catasṛṣu pṛṣṭhāni saptasv ārbhavaḥ pavamāna ekasyām agniṣṭomasāma

JB 2.125
|va	 athaiṣa ekatrikaḥ 
|vb	 prajananakāmo haitena yajeta 
|vc	 prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeyemāṃ vyaṣṭiṃ 
vyaśnuvīyeti 
|vd	 sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat 
|ve	 tam āharat 
|vf	 tenāyajata 
|vg	 sa aikṣata kena stuvīyeti 
|vh	 sa ātmānam apaśyat 
|vi	 tenāstuta sa aikṣata kena nveva stuvīyeti 
|vj	 sa prāṇāpānavyānān apaśyat 
|vk	 tair astuta 
|vl	 sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa evam eva 
viparyāsaṃ yajñaṃ samasthāpayat 
|vm	 tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyatemāṃ {Die Ed ohne Augment} vyaṣṭiṃ 
vyāśnuta yāsyeyam 
|vn	 bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyata imāṃ vyaṣṭiṃ vyaśnute ya evaṃ veda /125/


JB 2.126
|va	 tena haitenodaraś śāṇḍilya iyakṣāṃ cakre 
|vb	 tasya ha manasy evāsa ekatrikeṇa yajeyeti 
|vc	 na ha tu kasmai canovāca 
|vd	 atha hāsya jāyā gandharviṇy āsa 
|ve	 tāṃ hāyaṃ gandharva upanyeyāya 
|vf	 tāṃ hovācaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti 
|vg	 tena vai te patir yakṣyata iti 
|vh	 sā heyaṃ patiṃ papracchaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti 
|vi	 satyaṃ tvaṃ tena yakṣyasā3 iti 
|vj	 sa hovāca yad aham idam naiva kasmai canāvocaṃ manasy eva me 'bhūt kas ta 
idam avocad iti 
|vk	 yo māyaṃ gandharva upanyaitīti 
|vl	 taṃ vai tvaṃ pṛcchatād iti hovāca 
|vm	 yaṣṭavyaṃ tenā3 na yaṣṭavyā3m iti 
|vn	 taṃ ha papraccha yaṣṭavyaṃ tenā3 na yaṣṭavyā3m iti 
|vo	 sa hovāca yathā vā enaṃ sa vedaivam enaṃ vayaṃ vidmaḥ 
|vp	 yas tv asyetthaṃ stotraṃ vidyāt sa enena yajeteti yathainenādaḥ prajāpatis tuṣṭuve 
|vq	 teno ha sa nopadadharṣa yaṣṭum /126/


JB 2.127
|va	 śaśvad dhodaraś śāṇḍilyas tenaiva paṇāyyatāṃ jagāma yad asya manasy 
evāsaikatrikeṇa yajeyeti 
|vb	 sa vā eṣo 'nyatara iva yajñakratus supaṇāyyo vaineneṣṭvā bhavati supāpīyān vā 
|vc	 tasyaikasyāṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ saṃpadyate <upāsmai gāyatā nara> iti 
|vd	 tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamāno gāyatram eva gāyatryām utsedhas satobṛhatyām 
saiveḍā tan nidhanam āuśanam eva triṣṭubhi 
|ve	 etasyām ārbhavaḥ pavamāno <'yā rucā hariṇyā punāna> iti 
|vf	 etasyām aticchandasi gāyatrapārśvam 
|vg	 sa eva svaras tan nidhanam 
|vh	 saptapadā bhavati 
|vi	 sapta vai chandāṃsi 
|vj	 aticchandā vai sarvāṇi chandāṃsy abhibhavati 
|vk	 tad asya tat sarvāṇy eva chandāṃsy upetāni bhavanti 
|vl	 tad āhuḥ pañcanidhanam eva vāmadevyaṃ kāryam 
|vm	 pañcachandā ārbhavaḥ pavamānas saptasāmā 
|vn	 yad aha pañcanidhanāni tena chandāṃsi prati vibhavati 
|vo	 yad u vai saptapadā tena sāmāny atreva vibhavatīti 
|vp	 tad u vā āhur gāyatrapārśvam eva kāryam 
|vq	 sa eva svaras tan nidhanam 
|vr	 ātmā vai svaraḥ prajā nidhanam 
|vs	 etad eva samṛddhataram iva yad gāyatrapārśvam 
|vt	 tasmād gāyatrapārśvam eva kāryam iti 
|vu	 tāś caturviṃśati stotryās saṃpadyante 
|vv	 caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ 
|vw	 saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam 
|vx	 sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti /127/


JB 2.128
|va	 athaiṣa bṛhaspatisavaḥ 
|vb	 prajāpatiḥ prajās sasṛjānas sa vyasraṃsata 
|vc	 so 'nnaṃ bhūto 'śayat 
|vd	 tasya sarve devā mamatvina āsan mama mameti 
|ve	 te 'bruvan vīdaṃ bhajāmahā iti 
|vf	 tasya vibhāge na samapādayan 
|vg	 te 'bruvan ājim asyāyāmeti 
|vh	 ta ājim āyan 
|vi	 sa bṛhaspatir ājisaraṇaṃ panthānam apaśyat 
|vj	 sa pūrvaḥ parītya rathena vṛtvātiṣṭhat 
|vk	 te devās tan nāvindan yenātyasariṣyan 
|vl	 śaśvad dha yāvān eva rathayānāya tāvān ājir āsa 
|vm	 tato vai sa tam ājim udajayat 
|vn	 yad bṛhaspatir udajayat tasmād bṛhaspatisavaḥ 
|vo	 tam ājim ujjigivāṃsam indro 'bravīt puras tvā dadhe 
|vp	 mām anena yajñena yājayeti 
|vq	 tatheti 
|vr	 taṃ puro 'dhatta 
|vs	 tenainam ayājayat 
|vt	 tato vā indras sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śraiṣṭhyam agacchat 
|vu	 gacchati svānāṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ ya evaṃ veda 
|vv	 sa vā eṣa dvayor eva yajño brāhmaṇasya caiva rājanyasya ca 
|vw	 yad bṛhasoatir udajayat tena brāhmaṇasya 
|vx	 yad indro 'yajata teno rājanyasya 
|vy	 sa u hendrasyaivaikasya purohita āsa netareṣāṃ devānām 
|vz	 so 'kāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodhāṃ gaccheyam iti 
|vā	 sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata 
|vab	 tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodhām agacchat 
|vac	 bṛhaspatir vai devānāṃ purohitaḥ /128/


JB 2.129
|va	 sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati 
|vb	 brahma vai trivṛd brahma rathantaram 
|vc	 brahmaṇā vāva sa tad brahmavarcasam ārdhnot 
|vd	 brahmaṇaiva brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda 
|ve	 tasya trayastriṃśad dakṣiṇā bhavanti 
|vf	 trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ 
|vg	 devatānām eva purodhām āśnuta 
|vh	 aśvaś catustriṃśaḥ 
|vi	 prajāpater vā etad rūpaṃ yad aśvaḥ 
|vj	 saprajāpatikānām eva tena devatānāṃ purodhām āśnuta 
|vk	 tasyaitā yathāpūrvam anusavanaṃ dakṣiṇā dadāty aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty 
ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane 'nūbaṃdhyāyām ekām 
udavasānīyāyām ekām 
|vl	 anusavanam aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśaḥ 
|vm	 tad yā aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty aṣṭau vasavo vasūnām eva purodhām āśnuta 
|vn	 atha yā ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savan ekādaśa rudrā rudrāṇām eva tena purodhām 
āśnuta 
|vo	 atha yā dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane dvādaśādityā ādityānām eva tena purodhām āśnuta 
|vp	 atha yām anūbaṃdhyāyām ekāṃ mitrāvaruṇayor eva tena purodhām āśnuta 
|vq	 atha yām udavasānīyāyām ekāṃ karma karma me dakṣiṇāvad asad iti 
|vr	 atha yam anusavanam aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśaḥ prajāpater eva tena purodhām āśnuta /129/


JB 2.130
|va	 tad āhur manasaiva prātassavane dadyān manasā tṛtīyasavane mādhyaṃdina eva

JB 2.131
|va	 tasyāṣṭaśataṃ stotriyā bhavanti

|va	  tasmād indrāgnyoḥ kulāyaḥ

JB 2.134
|va	 athaiṣo 'gniṣṭut 
|vb	 indraṃ vai bhūtāni paryacakṣata triśīrṣāṇaṃ tvāṣṭram avadhīd yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ 
prādād arurmukhān avadhīd bṛhaspateḥ pratyavadhīt saṃdhāṃ saṃhitaṃ atītya 
namucer āsurasya śiraḥ prācchaitsīd ity etebhyo devakilbiṣebhyas 
|vc	 sa hāraṇya eva cacārānabhyavayan devān 
|vd	 sa u ha devān uvāca yājayata meti 
|ve	 neti hocuḥ 
|vf	 etā vai tvayā saṃdhā atītā etāni devakilbiṣāṇi kṛtāni na tvā yājayiṣyāma iti 
|vg	 atho hāsyāgnir eva sakhitama ivāsa deveṣu 
|vh	 sa u hāgnim uvāca tvaṃ mā yajayeti 
|vi	 tatheti hovāca 
|vj	 sa vai nu taṃ deveṣv icchāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti 
|vk	 sa ha taṃ deveṣu na viveda yenainaṃ sahāyājayiṣyat 
|vl	 sa hovāca na vai nu taṃ deveṣu vindāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti 
|vm	 taṃ vai mā tvam eva yājayeti 
|vn	 tatheti 
|vo	 so 'gnir ātmana evādhy etam agniṣṭutam atanuta 
|vp	 tenainam ayājayat 
|vq	 tasya sadyas sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ niradahat 
|vr	 sa yathāhir ahicchavyai nirmucyeta yathā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivṛhed evam eva 
sarvasmāt pāpmano niramucyata 
|vs	 sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā tapaty eṣa ha vā indraḥ 
|vt	 sa ya uktokta syād yo 'bhyākhyāyeta sa etena yajeta 
|vu	 sadyo haivāsya sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ nirdahati 
|vv	 sa yathāhir ahicchavyai nirmucyeta yathā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivṛhed evam eva

JB 2.135

JB 2.136
|va	 trivṛtā tejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo 'gniṣṭutā yajeta pañcadaśena vīryakāmas
